remote_cmd

Remote CMD - SSH 远程服务器管理工具

一个功能强大的 Python 库，用于管理远程服务器。 提供简洁的 API 用于 SSH 连接、命令执行和文件传输。

主要功能： - SSH 连接管理（支持密码和密钥认证） - 远程命令执行（包括 sudo 命令） - 文件上传和下载 - 主机配置管理 - 标签分类系统 - 批量连接测试 - 凭据加密存储 - 结构化日志系统

快速开始：

from remote_cmd import SSHClient, HostManager from remote_cmd.core.ssh_client import ConnectionConfig

创建连接配置

config = ConnectionConfig( ... hostname="192.168.1.100", ... username="admin", ... key_filename="~/.ssh/id_rsa" ... )

执行远程命令

with SSHClient(config) as client: ... result = client.execute("ls -la") ... print(result.stdout)

新架构（推荐）:

from remote_cmd.repository.json_host_repository import JsonHostRepository from remote_cmd.service.host_service import HostService

repo = JsonHostRepository("hosts.json") service = HostService(repo) service.add_host(host)

命令行使用： $ remote-cmd host add server1 192.168.1.100 admin -k ~/.ssh/id_rsa $ remote-cmd host list $ remote-cmd run server1 "uptime"

更多信息： - GitHub: https://github.com/Vae-Scrooge/remote-cmd - 文档: 参见 docs/ 目录

Author: Vae-Scrooge Version: 1.0.0 License: MIT

class SSHClient: 
134class SSHClient:
135    """
136    高级 SSH 客户端类
137
138    提供完整的 SSH 连接管理功能，支持上下文管理器模式，
139    可以使用 `with` 语句自动管理连接的生命周期。
140
141    主要功能：
142    - 建立/断开 SSH 连接
143    - 执行远程命令（普通命令和 sudo 命令）
144    - 文件上传/下载
145    - 远程目录浏览
146
147    使用示例：
148        >>> config = ConnectionConfig(
149        ...     hostname="example.com",
150        ...     username="admin",
151        ...     key_filename="~/.ssh/id_rsa"
152        ... )
153        >>> with SSHClient(config) as client:
154        ...     result = client.execute("ls -la")
155        ...     print(result.stdout)
156    """
157
158    def __init__(self, config: ConnectionConfig):
159        """
160        初始化 SSH 客户端
161
162        Args:
163            config: ConnectionConfig 对象，包含连接参数
164
165        Note:
166            初始化时不会建立连接，需要调用 connect() 方法或使用上下文管理器
167        """
168        self.config = config
169        self._client: Optional[paramiko.SSHClient] = None
170        self._sftp: Optional[paramiko.SFTPClient] = None
171
172    # ========================================================================
173    # 连接管理方法
174    # ========================================================================
175
176    def connect(self) -> "SSHClient":
177        """
178        建立 SSH 连接
179
180        根据配置信息建立到远程服务器的 SSH 连接。
181        支持密码认证和密钥认证两种方式。
182
183        Returns:
184            SSHClient: 返回自身，支持链式调用
185
186        Raises:
187            SSHConnectionError: 连接失败时抛出，包括：
188                - 认证失败
189                - 连接超时
190                - 主机无法解析
191                - 其他网络错误
192
193        Example:
194            >>> client = SSHClient(config)
195            >>> client.connect()  # 建立连接
196            >>> # 或链式调用
197            >>> client.connect().execute("ls")
198        """
199        try:
200            # 创建 SSH 客户端实例
201            self._client = paramiko.SSHClient()
202
203            # 设置主机密钥策略
204            policy = self.config.host_key_policy or paramiko.RejectPolicy()
205            self._client.set_missing_host_key_policy(policy)
206
207            # 加载 known_hosts 文件（可选）
208            known_hosts = self.config.known_hosts_file
209            if known_hosts:
210                known_hosts_path = Path(known_hosts).expanduser()
211                if known_hosts_path.exists():
212                    self._client.load_host_keys(str(known_hosts_path))
213                    logger.debug(f"已加载 known_hosts: {known_hosts_path}")
214                else:
215                    logger.warning(f"known_hosts 文件不存在: {known_hosts_path}")
216
217            # 构建连接参数字典
218            connect_kwargs = {
219                "hostname": self.config.hostname,
220                "port": self.config.port,
221                "username": self.config.username,
222                "timeout": self.config.timeout,
223                "compress": self.config.compress,
224            }
225
226            # 根据认证方式添加相应参数
227            if self.config.password:
228                # 密码认证
229                connect_kwargs["password"] = self.config.password
230            elif self.config.key_filename:
231                # 密钥认证：展开 ~ 并验证文件存在
232                key_path = Path(self.config.key_filename).expanduser()
233                if not key_path.exists():
234                    raise SSHConnectionError(f"SSH 密钥文件不存在: {key_path}")
235                connect_kwargs["key_filename"] = str(key_path)
236
237            # 记录连接日志
238            logger.info(f"正在连接到 {self.config.hostname}:{self.config.port}")
239
240            # 建立连接
241            self._client.connect(**connect_kwargs)
242            logger.info(f"成功连接到 {self.config.hostname}")
243
244            return self
245
246        except paramiko.AuthenticationException as e:
247            raise SSHConnectionError(f"认证失败: {e}") from e
248        except socket.timeout as e:
249            raise SSHConnectionError(f"连接超时: {self.config.hostname}") from e
250        except socket.gaierror as e:
251            raise SSHConnectionError(f"无法解析主机名: {self.config.hostname}") from e
252        except (OSError, paramiko.SSHException) as e:
253            raise SSHConnectionError(f"连接错误: {e}") from e
254
255    def disconnect(self) -> None:
256        """
257        断开 SSH 连接并清理资源
258
259        关闭 SFTP 和 SSH 连接，释放所有相关资源。
260        即使连接已断开或出现错误，此方法也能安全执行。
261        """
262        # 关闭 SFTP 连接
263        if self._sftp:
264            try:
265                self._sftp.close()
266                logger.debug("SFTP 连接已关闭")
267            except (OSError, paramiko.SSHException) as e:
268                logger.warning(f"关闭 SFTP 连接时出错: {e}")
269            finally:
270                self._sftp = None
271
272        # 关闭 SSH 连接
273        if self._client:
274            try:
275                self._client.close()
276                logger.debug("SSH 连接已关闭")
277            except (OSError, paramiko.SSHException) as e:
278                logger.warning(f"关闭 SSH 连接时出错: {e}")
279            finally:
280                self._client = None
281
282    def is_connected(self) -> bool:
283        """
284        检查 SSH 连接是否处于活动状态
285
286        Returns:
287            bool: 连接活动返回 True，否则返回 False
288        """
289        if not self._client:
290            return False
291
292        try:
293            transport = self._client.get_transport()
294            return transport is not None and transport.is_active()
295        except (AttributeError, OSError):
296            return False
297
298    def _get_sftp(self) -> paramiko.SFTPClient:
299        """获取 SFTP 客户端（延迟初始化）"""
300        if not self._client:
301            raise SSHConnectionError("未连接，请先调用 connect() 方法")
302        if not self._sftp:
303            self._sftp = self._client.open_sftp()
304        return self._sftp
305
306    # ========================================================================
307    # 上下文管理器支持
308    # ========================================================================
309
310    def __enter__(self) -> "SSHClient":
311        """
312        上下文管理器入口：自动建立连接
313
314        Returns:
315            SSHClient: 已连接的客户端实例
316        """
317        return self.connect()
318
319    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb) -> None:
320        """
321        上下文管理器出口：自动断开连接
322
323        Args:
324            exc_type: 异常类型
325            exc_val: 异常值
326            exc_tb: 异常追踪信息
327        """
328        self.disconnect()
329
330    # ========================================================================
331    # 命令执行方法
332    # ========================================================================
333
334    def execute(
335        self,
336        command: str,
337        timeout: Optional[int] = None,
338        environment: Optional[dict[str, str]] = None,
339    ) -> CommandResult:
340        """
341        在远程服务器上执行命令
342
343        Args:
344            command: 要执行的命令字符串
345            timeout: 命令执行超时时间（秒），None 表示使用默认超时
346            environment: 环境变量字典，将在命令执行前设置
347
348        Returns:
349            CommandResult: 包含命令执行结果的对象
350
351        Raises:
352            SSHCommandError: 命令执行失败时抛出
353            SSHConnectionError: 未连接时抛出
354
355        Example:
356            >>> result = client.execute("ls -la")
357            >>> if result.success:
358            ...     print(result.stdout)
359        """
360        # 检查连接状态
361        if not self._client:
362            raise SSHConnectionError("未连接，请先调用 connect() 方法")
363
364        try:
365            logger.debug(f"执行命令: {command}")
366
367            # 构建环境变量设置命令
368            env_str = ""
369            if environment:
370                env_vars = [f"export {k}={v}" for k, v in environment.items()]
371                env_str = "; ".join(env_vars) + "; "
372
373            # 组合完整命令（切换到用户主目录执行）
374            full_command = f"{env_str}cd ~ && {command}"
375
376            # 执行命令
377            stdin, stdout, stderr = self._client.exec_command(full_command, timeout=timeout)
378
379            # 获取命令执行结果
380            exit_code = stdout.channel.recv_exit_status()
381            stdout_data = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
382            stderr_data = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
383
384            # 构建结果对象
385            result = CommandResult(
386                command=command,
387                stdout=stdout_data,
388                stderr=stderr_data,
389                exit_code=exit_code,
390            )
391
392            logger.debug(f"命令执行完成，退出码: {exit_code}")
393            return result
394
395        except (paramiko.SSHException, OSError) as e:
396            raise SSHCommandError(f"执行命令 '{command}' 失败: {e}") from e
397
398    def execute_sudo(
399        self,
400        command: str,
401        password: Optional[str] = None,
402        timeout: Optional[int] = None,
403    ) -> CommandResult:
404        """
405        以 sudo 权限执行命令（安全实现）
406
407        Args:
408            command: 要执行的命令字符串（不需要包含 sudo 前缀）
409            password: sudo 密码（如果需要），None 表示使用无密码 sudo
410            timeout: 命令执行超时时间（秒）
411
412        Returns:
413            CommandResult: 包含命令执行结果的对象
414
415        Note:
416            - 如果提供了 password，使用 exec_command + -S 从 stdin 传入密码
417            - 密码不会出现在进程列表或日志中
418            - stdout 和 stderr 保持独立分离
419
420        Example:
421            >>> result = client.execute_sudo("systemctl restart nginx", password="mypass")
422        """
423        if not self._client:
424            raise SSHConnectionError("未连接，请先调用 connect() 方法")
425
426        if password is None:
427            full_command = f"sudo {command}"
428            return self.execute(full_command, timeout)
429
430        # 使用 exec_command + sudo -S 从 stdin 传入密码，保持 stdout/stderr 分离
431        try:
432            full_command = f"sudo -S {command}"
433            stdin, stdout, stderr = self._client.exec_command(
434                full_command, timeout=timeout, get_pty=True
435            )
436            stdin.write(password + "\n")
437            stdin.flush()
438
439            exit_code = stdout.channel.recv_exit_status()
440            stdout_data = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
441            stderr_data = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
442
443            return CommandResult(
444                command=command,
445                stdout=stdout_data,
446                stderr=stderr_data,
447                exit_code=exit_code,
448            )
449        except paramiko.SSHException as e:
450            raise SSHCommandError(f"执行 sudo 命令 '{command}' 失败: {e}") from e
451
452    # ========================================================================
453    # 文件传输方法
454    # ========================================================================
455
456    def upload_file(self, local_path: str, remote_path: str) -> None:
457        """
458        上传本地文件到远程服务器
459
460        Args:
461            local_path: 本地文件路径
462            remote_path: 远程目标路径（绝对路径）
463
464        Raises:
465            SSHFileTransferError: 文件传输失败时抛出
466            SSHConnectionError: 未连接时抛出
467
468        Example:
469            >>> client.upload_file("./script.sh", "/home/user/script.sh")
470        """
471        sftp = self._get_sftp()
472
473        # 验证本地文件存在
474        local_file = Path(local_path)
475        if not local_file.exists():
476            raise SSHFileTransferError(f"本地文件不存在: {local_path}")
477
478        # 执行上传
479        try:
480            logger.info(f"上传文件: {local_path} -> {remote_path}")
481            sftp.put(str(local_file), remote_path)
482            logger.info("文件上传完成")
483        except (paramiko.SSHException, OSError) as e:
484            raise SSHFileTransferError(f"文件上传失败: {e}") from e
485
486    def download_file(self, remote_path: str, local_path: str) -> None:
487        """
488        从远程服务器下载文件到本地
489
490        Args:
491            remote_path: 远程文件路径（绝对路径）
492            local_path: 本地目标路径
493
494        Raises:
495            SSHFileTransferError: 文件传输失败时抛出
496            SSHConnectionError: 未连接时抛出
497
498        Note:
499            如果本地目录不存在，将自动创建
500
501        Example:
502            >>> client.download_file("/var/log/syslog", "./logs/syslog")
503        """
504        sftp = self._get_sftp()
505
506        # 确保本地目录存在
507        local_file = Path(local_path)
508        local_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
509
510        # 执行下载
511        try:
512            logger.info(f"下载文件: {remote_path} -> {local_path}")
513            sftp.get(remote_path, str(local_file))
514            logger.info("文件下载完成")
515        except (paramiko.SSHException, OSError) as e:
516            raise SSHFileTransferError(f"文件下载失败: {e}") from e
517
518    def list_remote_directory(self, remote_path: str = ".") -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
519        """
520        列出远程目录内容
521
522        Args:
523            remote_path: 远程目录路径，默认为当前目录
524
525        Returns:
526            List[Dict[str, Any]]: 目录项信息列表，每个字典包含：
527                - name: 文件/目录名
528                - size: 文件大小（字节）
529                - mode: 权限模式（八进制字符串）
530                - mtime: 修改时间戳
531                - is_dir: 是否为目录
532
533        Raises:
534            SSHFileTransferError: 列出目录失败时抛出
535            SSHConnectionError: 未连接时抛出
536
537        Example:
538            >>> entries = client.list_remote_directory("/home/user")
539            >>> for entry in entries:
540            ...     print(f"{entry['name']}: {entry['size']} bytes")
541        """
542        sftp = self._get_sftp()
543
544        try:
545            entries = []
546            for entry in sftp.listdir_attr(remote_path):
547                mode = entry.st_mode if entry.st_mode is not None else 0
548                entries.append(
549                    {
550                        "name": entry.filename,
551                        "size": entry.st_size,
552                        "mode": oct(mode)[-3:] if mode else "000",
553                        "mtime": entry.st_mtime,
554                        "is_dir": bool(mode & stat.S_IFDIR) if mode else False,
555                    }
556                )
557            return entries
558        except (paramiko.SSHException, OSError) as e:
559            raise SSHFileTransferError(f"列出远程目录失败: {e}") from e
560
561    def create_remote_directory(self, path: str) -> None:
562        """创建远程目录（支持递归创建）"""
563        sftp = self._get_sftp()
564
565        def _makedirs(sftp_client, remote_path):
566            if remote_path == "/":
567                return
568            try:
569                sftp_client.stat(remote_path)
570            except OSError:
571                _makedirs(sftp_client, str(Path(remote_path).parent))
572                sftp_client.mkdir(remote_path)
573
574        try:
575            _makedirs(sftp, path)
576            logger.info(f"已创建远程目录: {path}")
577        except (paramiko.SSHException, OSError) as e:
578            raise SSHFileTransferError(f"创建远程目录失败: {e}") from e
579
580    def remove_remote_file(self, path: str) -> None:
581        """删除远程文件"""
582        sftp = self._get_sftp()
583        try:
584            sftp.remove(path)
585            logger.info(f"已删除远程文件: {path}")
586        except (paramiko.SSHException, OSError) as e:
587            raise SSHFileTransferError(f"删除远程文件失败: {e}") from e
588
589    def remove_remote_directory(self, path: str, recursive: bool = False) -> None:
590        """删除远程目录"""
591        sftp = self._get_sftp()
592
593        def _rm_recursive(sftp_client, remote_path):
594            """递归删除目录内容，先收集后删除以避免不一致状态"""
595            entries = []
596            try:
597                for entry in sftp_client.listdir_attr(remote_path):
598                    entries.append((entry.filename, bool(entry.st_mode & stat.S_IFDIR)))
599            except OSError:
600                return
601            # 先删除文件，再递归删除子目录
602            for name, is_dir in entries:
603                full_path = f"{remote_path}/{name}"
604                if is_dir:
605                    _rm_recursive(sftp_client, full_path)
606                else:
607                    sftp_client.remove(full_path)
608            sftp_client.rmdir(remote_path)
609
610        try:
611            if recursive:
612                _rm_recursive(sftp, path)
613            else:
614                sftp.rmdir(path)
615            logger.info(f"已删除远程目录: {path}")
616        except (paramiko.SSHException, OSError) as e:
617            raise SSHFileTransferError(f"删除远程目录失败: {e}") from e
618
619    def remote_file_exists(self, path: str) -> bool:
620        """检查远程文件是否存在"""
621        try:
622            sftp = self._get_sftp()
623            sftp.stat(path)
624            return True
625        except OSError:
626            return False
627        except SSHConnectionError:
628            return False
629
630    def get_remote_file_info(self, path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
631        """获取远程文件信息"""
632        sftp = self._get_sftp()
633        try:
634            stat_result = sftp.stat(path)
635            mode = stat_result.st_mode
636            return {
637                "name": Path(path).name,
638                "size": stat_result.st_size,
639                "mode": oct(mode)[-3:] if mode else "000",
640                "mtime": stat_result.st_mtime,
641                "is_dir": stat.S_ISDIR(mode),
642                "is_file": stat.S_ISREG(mode),
643            }
644        except (paramiko.SSHException, OSError) as e:
645            raise SSHFileTransferError(f"获取文件信息失败: {e}") from e

高级 SSH 客户端类

提供完整的 SSH 连接管理功能，支持上下文管理器模式， 可以使用 with 语句自动管理连接的生命周期。

主要功能：

  • 建立/断开 SSH 连接
  • 执行远程命令（普通命令和 sudo 命令）
  • 文件上传/下载
  • 远程目录浏览

使用示例：

config = ConnectionConfig( ... hostname="example.com", ... username="admin", ... key_filename="~/.ssh/id_rsa" ... ) with SSHClient(config) as client: ... result = client.execute("ls -la") ... print(result.stdout)

SSHClient(config: remote_cmd.core.ssh_client.ConnectionConfig)

159        """
160        初始化 SSH 客户端
161
162        Args:
163            config: ConnectionConfig 对象，包含连接参数
164
165        Note:
166            初始化时不会建立连接，需要调用 connect() 方法或使用上下文管理器
167        """

初始化 SSH 客户端

Args: config: ConnectionConfig 对象，包含连接参数

Note: 初始化时不会建立连接，需要调用 connect() 方法或使用上下文管理器

config
def connect(self) -> 'SSHClient': 
176    def connect(self) -> "SSHClient":
177        """
178        建立 SSH 连接
179
180        根据配置信息建立到远程服务器的 SSH 连接。
181        支持密码认证和密钥认证两种方式。
182
183        Returns:
184            SSHClient: 返回自身，支持链式调用
185
186        Raises:
187            SSHConnectionError: 连接失败时抛出，包括：
188                - 认证失败
189                - 连接超时
190                - 主机无法解析
191                - 其他网络错误
192
193        Example:
194            >>> client = SSHClient(config)
195            >>> client.connect()  # 建立连接
196            >>> # 或链式调用
197            >>> client.connect().execute("ls")
198        """
199        try:
200            # 创建 SSH 客户端实例
201            self._client = paramiko.SSHClient()
202
203            # 设置主机密钥策略
204            policy = self.config.host_key_policy or paramiko.RejectPolicy()
205            self._client.set_missing_host_key_policy(policy)
206
207            # 加载 known_hosts 文件（可选）
208            known_hosts = self.config.known_hosts_file
209            if known_hosts:
210                known_hosts_path = Path(known_hosts).expanduser()
211                if known_hosts_path.exists():
212                    self._client.load_host_keys(str(known_hosts_path))
213                    logger.debug(f"已加载 known_hosts: {known_hosts_path}")
214                else:
215                    logger.warning(f"known_hosts 文件不存在: {known_hosts_path}")
216
217            # 构建连接参数字典
218            connect_kwargs = {
219                "hostname": self.config.hostname,
220                "port": self.config.port,
221                "username": self.config.username,
222                "timeout": self.config.timeout,
223                "compress": self.config.compress,
224            }
225
226            # 根据认证方式添加相应参数
227            if self.config.password:
228                # 密码认证
229                connect_kwargs["password"] = self.config.password
230            elif self.config.key_filename:
231                # 密钥认证：展开 ~ 并验证文件存在
232                key_path = Path(self.config.key_filename).expanduser()
233                if not key_path.exists():
234                    raise SSHConnectionError(f"SSH 密钥文件不存在: {key_path}")
235                connect_kwargs["key_filename"] = str(key_path)
236
237            # 记录连接日志
238            logger.info(f"正在连接到 {self.config.hostname}:{self.config.port}")
239
240            # 建立连接
241            self._client.connect(**connect_kwargs)
242            logger.info(f"成功连接到 {self.config.hostname}")
243
244            return self
245
246        except paramiko.AuthenticationException as e:
247            raise SSHConnectionError(f"认证失败: {e}") from e
248        except socket.timeout as e:
249            raise SSHConnectionError(f"连接超时: {self.config.hostname}") from e
250        except socket.gaierror as e:
251            raise SSHConnectionError(f"无法解析主机名: {self.config.hostname}") from e
252        except (OSError, paramiko.SSHException) as e:
253            raise SSHConnectionError(f"连接错误: {e}") from e

建立 SSH 连接

根据配置信息建立到远程服务器的 SSH 连接。 支持密码认证和密钥认证两种方式。

Returns: SSHClient: 返回自身，支持链式调用

Raises: SSHConnectionError: 连接失败时抛出，包括： - 认证失败 - 连接超时 - 主机无法解析 - 其他网络错误

Example:

client = SSHClient(config) client.connect() # 建立连接

或链式调用

client.connect().execute("ls")

def disconnect(self) -> None: 
255    def disconnect(self) -> None:
256        """
257        断开 SSH 连接并清理资源
258
259        关闭 SFTP 和 SSH 连接，释放所有相关资源。
260        即使连接已断开或出现错误，此方法也能安全执行。
261        """
262        # 关闭 SFTP 连接
263        if self._sftp:
264            try:
265                self._sftp.close()
266                logger.debug("SFTP 连接已关闭")
267            except (OSError, paramiko.SSHException) as e:
268                logger.warning(f"关闭 SFTP 连接时出错: {e}")
269            finally:
270                self._sftp = None
271
272        # 关闭 SSH 连接
273        if self._client:
274            try:
275                self._client.close()
276                logger.debug("SSH 连接已关闭")
277            except (OSError, paramiko.SSHException) as e:
278                logger.warning(f"关闭 SSH 连接时出错: {e}")
279            finally:
280                self._client = None

断开 SSH 连接并清理资源

关闭 SFTP 和 SSH 连接，释放所有相关资源。 即使连接已断开或出现错误，此方法也能安全执行。

def is_connected(self) -> bool: 
282    def is_connected(self) -> bool:
283        """
284        检查 SSH 连接是否处于活动状态
285
286        Returns:
287            bool: 连接活动返回 True，否则返回 False
288        """
289        if not self._client:

291
292        try:

295        except (AttributeError, OSError):

检查 SSH 连接是否处于活动状态

Returns: bool: 连接活动返回 True，否则返回 False

def execute( self, command: str, timeout: int | None = None, environment: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> remote_cmd.core.ssh_client.CommandResult: 
334    def execute(
335        self,
336        command: str,
337        timeout: Optional[int] = None,
338        environment: Optional[dict[str, str]] = None,
339    ) -> CommandResult:
340        """
341        在远程服务器上执行命令
342
343        Args:
344            command: 要执行的命令字符串
345            timeout: 命令执行超时时间（秒），None 表示使用默认超时
346            environment: 环境变量字典，将在命令执行前设置
347
348        Returns:
349            CommandResult: 包含命令执行结果的对象
350
351        Raises:
352            SSHCommandError: 命令执行失败时抛出
353            SSHConnectionError: 未连接时抛出
354
355        Example:
356            >>> result = client.execute("ls -la")
357            >>> if result.success:
358            ...     print(result.stdout)
359        """
360        # 检查连接状态
361        if not self._client:
362            raise SSHConnectionError("未连接，请先调用 connect() 方法")
363
364        try:
365            logger.debug(f"执行命令: {command}")
366
367            # 构建环境变量设置命令
368            env_str = ""
369            if environment:
370                env_vars = [f"export {k}={v}" for k, v in environment.items()]
371                env_str = "; ".join(env_vars) + "; "
372
373            # 组合完整命令（切换到用户主目录执行）
374            full_command = f"{env_str}cd ~ && {command}"
375
376            # 执行命令
377            stdin, stdout, stderr = self._client.exec_command(full_command, timeout=timeout)
378
379            # 获取命令执行结果
380            exit_code = stdout.channel.recv_exit_status()
381            stdout_data = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
382            stderr_data = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
383
384            # 构建结果对象
385            result = CommandResult(
386                command=command,
387                stdout=stdout_data,
388                stderr=stderr_data,
389                exit_code=exit_code,
390            )
391
392            logger.debug(f"命令执行完成，退出码: {exit_code}")
393            return result
394
395        except (paramiko.SSHException, OSError) as e:
396            raise SSHCommandError(f"执行命令 '{command}' 失败: {e}") from e

在远程服务器上执行命令

Args: command: 要执行的命令字符串 timeout: 命令执行超时时间（秒），None 表示使用默认超时 environment: 环境变量字典，将在命令执行前设置

Returns: CommandResult: 包含命令执行结果的对象

Raises: SSHCommandError: 命令执行失败时抛出 SSHConnectionError: 未连接时抛出

Example:

result = client.execute("ls -la") if result.success: ... print(result.stdout)

def execute_sudo( self, command: str, password: str | None = None, timeout: int | None = None) -> remote_cmd.core.ssh_client.CommandResult: 
398    def execute_sudo(
399        self,
400        command: str,
401        password: Optional[str] = None,
402        timeout: Optional[int] = None,
403    ) -> CommandResult:
404        """
405        以 sudo 权限执行命令（安全实现）
406
407        Args:
408            command: 要执行的命令字符串（不需要包含 sudo 前缀）
409            password: sudo 密码（如果需要），None 表示使用无密码 sudo
410            timeout: 命令执行超时时间（秒）
411
412        Returns:
413            CommandResult: 包含命令执行结果的对象
414
415        Note:
416            - 如果提供了 password，使用 exec_command + -S 从 stdin 传入密码
417            - 密码不会出现在进程列表或日志中
418            - stdout 和 stderr 保持独立分离
419
420        Example:
421            >>> result = client.execute_sudo("systemctl restart nginx", password="mypass")
422        """
423        if not self._client:
424            raise SSHConnectionError("未连接，请先调用 connect() 方法")
425
426        if password is None:
427            full_command = f"sudo {command}"
428            return self.execute(full_command, timeout)
429
430        # 使用 exec_command + sudo -S 从 stdin 传入密码，保持 stdout/stderr 分离
431        try:
432            full_command = f"sudo -S {command}"
433            stdin, stdout, stderr = self._client.exec_command(
434                full_command, timeout=timeout, get_pty=True
435            )
436            stdin.write(password + "\n")
437            stdin.flush()
438
439            exit_code = stdout.channel.recv_exit_status()
440            stdout_data = stdout.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
441            stderr_data = stderr.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
442
443            return CommandResult(
444                command=command,
445                stdout=stdout_data,
446                stderr=stderr_data,
447                exit_code=exit_code,
448            )
449        except paramiko.SSHException as e:
450            raise SSHCommandError(f"执行 sudo 命令 '{command}' 失败: {e}") from e

以 sudo 权限执行命令（安全实现）

Args: command: 要执行的命令字符串（不需要包含 sudo 前缀） password: sudo 密码（如果需要），None 表示使用无密码 sudo timeout: 命令执行超时时间（秒）

Returns: CommandResult: 包含命令执行结果的对象

Note: - 如果提供了 password，使用 exec_command + -S 从 stdin 传入密码 - 密码不会出现在进程列表或日志中 - stdout 和 stderr 保持独立分离

Example:

result = client.execute_sudo("systemctl restart nginx", password="mypass")

519        """
520        列出远程目录内容
521
522        Args:
523            remote_path: 远程目录路径，默认为当前目录
524
525        Returns:
526            List[Dict[str, Any]]: 目录项信息列表，每个字典包含：
527                - name: 文件/目录名
528                - size: 文件大小（字节）
529                - mode: 权限模式（八进制字符串）
530                - mtime: 修改时间戳
531                - is_dir: 是否为目录
532
533        Raises:
534            SSHFileTransferError: 列出目录失败时抛出
535            SSHConnectionError: 未连接时抛出
536
537        Example:
538            >>> entries = client.list_remote_directory("/home/user")
539            >>> for entry in entries:
540            ...     print(f"{entry['name']}: {entry['size']} bytes")
541        """
542        sftp = self._get_sftp()
543
544        try:
545            entries = []
546            for entry in sftp.listdir_attr(remote_path):
547                mode = entry.st_mode if entry.st_mode is not None else 0
548                entries.append(
549                    {
550                        "name": entry.filename,
551                        "size": entry.st_size,
552                        "mode": oct(mode)[-3:] if mode else "000",
553                        "mtime": entry.st_mtime,
554                        "is_dir": bool(mode & stat.S_IFDIR) if mode else False,
555                    }
556                )
557            return entries
558        except (paramiko.SSHException, OSError) as e:
559            raise SSHFileTransferError(f"列出远程目录失败: {e}") from e

def create_remote_directory(self, path: str) -> None: 
561    def create_remote_directory(self, path: str) -> None:
562        """创建远程目录（支持递归创建）"""
563        sftp = self._get_sftp()
564
565        def _makedirs(sftp_client, remote_path):
566            if remote_path == "/":
567                return
568            try:
569                sftp_client.stat(remote_path)
570            except OSError:
571                _makedirs(sftp_client, str(Path(remote_path).parent))
572                sftp_client.mkdir(remote_path)
573
574        try:
575            _makedirs(sftp, path)
576            logger.info(f"已创建远程目录: {path}")
577        except (paramiko.SSHException, OSError) as e:
578            raise SSHFileTransferError(f"创建远程目录失败: {e}") from e

def remove_remote_directory(self, path: str, recursive: bool = False) -> None: 
589    def remove_remote_directory(self, path: str, recursive: bool = False) -> None:
590        """删除远程目录"""
591        sftp = self._get_sftp()
592
593        def _rm_recursive(sftp_client, remote_path):
594            """递归删除目录内容，先收集后删除以避免不一致状态"""
595            entries = []
596            try:
597                for entry in sftp_client.listdir_attr(remote_path):
598                    entries.append((entry.filename, bool(entry.st_mode & stat.S_IFDIR)))
599            except OSError:
600                return
601            # 先删除文件，再递归删除子目录
602            for name, is_dir in entries:
603                full_path = f"{remote_path}/{name}"
604                if is_dir:
605                    _rm_recursive(sftp_client, full_path)
606                else:
607                    sftp_client.remove(full_path)
608            sftp_client.rmdir(remote_path)
609
610        try:
611            if recursive:
612                _rm_recursive(sftp, path)
613            else:
614                sftp.rmdir(path)
615            logger.info(f"已删除远程目录: {path}")
616        except (paramiko.SSHException, OSError) as e:
617            raise SSHFileTransferError(f"删除远程目录失败: {e}") from e

class AsyncSSHClient: 
 35class AsyncSSHClient:
 36    """基于 asyncssh 的原生异步 SSH 客户端。
 37
 38    对外接口与同步 `SSHClient` 一致，是项目中唯一的异步 SSH 客户端实现。
 39
 40    Args:
 41        config: SSH 连接配置
 42        loop: 可选事件循环（已忽略；asyncssh 自行从当前事件循环获取，保留参数仅为
 43            向后兼容）
 44
 45    Note:
 46        本类不持有任何线程池，真正在事件循环上完成 I/O，可与其他 asyncssh 连接
 47        并发复用同一事件循环。
 48    """
 49
 50    def __init__(
 51        self,
 52        config: ConnectionConfig,
 53        loop: Optional[Any] = None,
 54    ) -> None:
 55        self.config = config
 56        self._conn: Optional[asyncssh.SSHClientConnection] = None
 57        self._sftp: Optional[asyncssh.SFTPClient] = None
 58        # 保留 loop 入参仅为向后兼容，asyncssh 自行从当前 event loop 取用
 59        self._loop = loop
 60
 61    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
 62    # 连接管理
 63    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
 64    async def connect(self) -> "AsyncSSHClient":
 65        """异步建立 SSH 连接。
 66
 67        Returns:
 68            AsyncSSHClient: 已连接的客户端实例（支持链式调用）
 69
 70        Raises:
 71            SSHConnectionError: 连接/认证失败时抛出，包含原因映射
 72        """
 73        if self.is_connected():
 74            return self
 75
 76        connect_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
 77            "host": self.config.hostname,
 78            "port": self.config.port,
 79            "username": self.config.username,
 80            "known_hosts": self._build_known_hosts(),
 81            "login_timeout": self.config.timeout,
 82        }
 83
 84        # 认证方式：密码优先，其次密钥，最后交给 asyncssh 默认（含 agent）
 85        if self.config.password:
 86            connect_kwargs["password"] = self.config.password
 87        elif self.config.key_filename:
 88            key_path = Path(self.config.key_filename).expanduser()
 89            if not key_path.exists():
 90                raise SSHConnectionError(f"SSH 密钥文件不存在: {key_path}")
 91            connect_kwargs["client_keys"] = [str(key_path)]
 92
 93        logger.info(f"正在连接到 {self.config.hostname}:{self.config.port}")
 94        try:
 95            self._conn = await asyncssh.connect(**connect_kwargs)
 96        except asyncssh.PermissionDenied as e:
 97            raise SSHConnectionError(f"认证失败: {e}") from e
 98        except (OSError, asyncssh.Error) as e:
 99            msg = str(e).lower()
100            if (
101                "timed out" in msg
102                or "timeout" in msg
103                or isinstance(e, asyncssh.TimeoutError)
104            ):
105                raise SSHConnectionError(f"连接超时: {self.config.hostname}") from e
106            raise SSHConnectionError(f"连接错误: {e}") from e
107
108        logger.info(f"成功连接到 {self.config.hostname}")
109        return self
110
111    def _build_known_hosts(self) -> Any:
112        """根据 ConnectionConfig 构建 asyncssh known_hosts 配置。
113
114        策略对齐同步 SSHClient：
115        - 若显式提供 known_hosts_file，使用该文件做严格校验
116        - 若配置传入 paramiko.AutoAddPolicy 等价信号（通过 host_key_policy 字符串
117          'auto' 或 False 判定），自动接受新主机密钥（仅用于测试/受控环境）
118        - 默认使用 asyncssh 默认策略（~/.ssh/known_hosts）
119        """
120        if self.config.known_hosts_file:
121            path = Path(self.config.known_hosts_file).expanduser()
122            return str(path)
123        policy = self.config.host_key_policy
124        # 约定：传入字符串 "auto" 视为自动添加（受控场景）
125        if isinstance(policy, str) and policy.lower() == "auto":
126            return None
127        # 默认交由 asyncssh 处理用户 ~/.ssh/known_hosts
128        return ()
129
130    async def disconnect(self) -> None:
131        """异步断开 SSH 连接并清理 SFTP 资源。即使连接已断开也能安全调用。"""
132        if self._sftp is not None:
133            try:
134                # asyncssh SFTPClient.exit() 是同步方法，仅关闭通道资源
135                self._sftp.exit()
136            except (OSError, asyncssh.Error) as e:
137                logger.warning(f"关闭 SFTP 连接时出错: {e}")
138            finally:
139                self._sftp = None
140
141        if self._conn is not None:
142            try:
143                self._conn.close()
144                # await close 完成底层通道清理，但忽略可能抛出的 ConnectionLost / asyncssh.Error
145                await self._conn.wait_closed()
146            except (OSError, asyncssh.Error) as e:
147                logger.warning(f"关闭 SSH 连接时出错: {e}")
148            finally:
149                self._conn = None
150
151    def is_connected(self) -> bool:
152        """检查连接是否处于活动状态。"""
153        return self._conn is not None and not self._conn.is_closed()
154
155    async def _get_conn(self) -> asyncssh.SSHClientConnection:
156        if self._conn is None:
157            raise SSHConnectionError("未连接，请先调用 connect() 方法")
158        return self._conn
159
160    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
161    # 命令执行
162    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
163    async def execute(
164        self,
165        command: str,
166        timeout: Optional[int] = None,
167        environment: Optional[dict[str, str]] = None,
168    ) -> CommandResult:
169        """异步执行远程命令。
170
171        Args:
172            command: 要执行的命令字符串
173            timeout: 命令执行超时（秒），None 表示不限
174            environment: 命令执行前注入的环境变量
175
176        Returns:
177            CommandResult: 命令结果（与同步实现字段一致）
178
179        Raises:
180            SSHCommandError: 命令执行失败时抛出
181            SSHConnectionError: 未连接时抛出
182        """
183        conn = await self._get_conn()
184        env_str = ""
185        if environment:
186            env_str = "; ".join(f"export {k}={v}" for k, v in environment.items()) + "; "
187        full_command = f"{env_str}cd ~ && {command}"
188        logger.debug(f"执行命令: {command}")
189        try:
190            result = await conn.run(
191                full_command,
192                timeout=timeout,
193                check=False,
194                env={k: str(v) for k, v in (environment or {}).items()},
195            )
196        except (OSError, asyncssh.Error) as e:
197            raise SSHCommandError(f"执行命令 '{command}' 失败: {e}") from e
198
199        stdout_data = result.stdout if isinstance(result.stdout, str) else (
200            result.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if result.stdout else ""
201        )
202        stderr_data = result.stderr if isinstance(result.stderr, str) else (
203            result.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if result.stderr else ""
204        )
205        exit_code = int(result.exit_status) if result.exit_status is not None else -1
206
207        return CommandResult(
208            command=command,
209            stdout=stdout_data,
210            stderr=stderr_data,
211            exit_code=exit_code,
212        )
213
214    async def execute_sudo(
215        self,
216        command: str,
217        password: Optional[str] = None,
218        timeout: Optional[int] = None,
219    ) -> CommandResult:
220        """以 sudo 权限异步执行命令（安全实现：密码通过 stdin 传入，不进入进程列表）。"""
221        conn = await self._get_conn()
222        if password is None:
223            return await self.execute(f"sudo {command}", timeout=timeout)
224
225        try:
226            proc: asyncssh.SSHClientProcess = await conn.create_process(
227                f"sudo -S {command}",
228                timeout=timeout,
229            )
230        except (OSError, asyncssh.Error) as e:
231            raise SSHCommandError(f"执行 sudo 命令 '{command}' 失败: {e}") from e
232
233        try:
234            proc.stdin.write(password + "\n")
235            proc.stdin.write_eof()
236            result = await proc.wait()
237        except (OSError, asyncssh.Error) as e:
238            raise SSHCommandError(f"执行 sudo 命令 '{command}' 失败: {e}") from e
239
240        stdout_data = (
241            result.stdout if isinstance(result.stdout, str)
242            else (result.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if result.stdout else "")
243        )
244        stderr_data = (
245            result.stderr if isinstance(result.stderr, str)
246            else (result.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if result.stderr else "")
247        )
248        return CommandResult(
249            command=command,
250            stdout=stdout_data,
251            stderr=stderr_data,
252            exit_code=int(result.exit_status) if result.exit_status is not None else -1,
253        )
254
255    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
256    # SFTP / 文件传输
257    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
258    async def _get_sftp(self) -> asyncssh.SFTPClient:
259        conn = await self._get_conn()
260        if self._sftp is None:
261            try:
262                self._sftp = await conn.start_sftp_client()
263            except (OSError, asyncssh.Error) as e:
264                raise SSHFileTransferError(f"打开 SFTP 通道失败: {e}") from e
265        return self._sftp
266
267    async def upload_file(self, local_path: str, remote_path: str) -> None:
268        """异步上传本地文件到远程服务器。"""
269        sftp = await self._get_sftp()
270        local_file = Path(local_path)
271        if not local_file.exists():
272            raise SSHFileTransferError(f"本地文件不存在: {local_path}")
273        logger.info(f"上传文件: {local_path} -> {remote_path}")
274        try:
275            await sftp.put(str(local_file), remote_path)
276        except (OSError, asyncssh.Error) as e:
277            raise SSHFileTransferError(f"文件上传失败: {e}") from e
278        logger.info("文件上传完成")
279
280    async def download_file(self, remote_path: str, local_path: str) -> None:
281        """异步从远程服务器下载文件到本地。"""
282        sftp = await self._get_sftp()
283        local_file = Path(local_path)
284        local_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
285        logger.info(f"下载文件: {remote_path} -> {local_path}")
286        try:
287            await sftp.get(remote_path, str(local_file))
288        except (OSError, asyncssh.Error) as e:
289            raise SSHFileTransferError(f"文件下载失败: {e}") from e
290        logger.info("文件下载完成")
291
292    async def list_remote_directory(self, remote_path: str = ".") -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
293        """异步列出远程目录内容（结构与同步 SSHClient 一致）。"""
294        sftp = await self._get_sftp()
295        try:
296            names = await sftp.readdir(remote_path)
297        except (OSError, asyncssh.Error) as e:
298            raise SSHFileTransferError(f"列出远程目录失败: {e}") from e
299
300        entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
301        for entry in names:
302            attrs = entry.attrs
303            mode = attrs.permissions if hasattr(attrs, "permissions") else None
304            entries.append(
305                {
306                    "name": entry.filename,
307                    "size": attrs.size if hasattr(attrs, "size") else 0,
308                    "mode": oct(int(mode))[-3:] if mode else "000",
309                    "mtime": attrs.mtime if hasattr(attrs, "mtime") else 0,
310                    "is_dir": bool(mode & stat.S_IFDIR) if mode else False,
311                }
312            )
313        return entries
314
315    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
316    # 上下文管理器
317    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
318    async def __aenter__(self) -> "AsyncSSHClient":
319        await self.connect()
320        return self
321
322    async def __aexit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb) -> None:
323        await self.disconnect()

174            environment: 命令执行前注入的环境变量
175
176        Returns:
177            CommandResult: 命令结果（与同步实现字段一致）
178
179        Raises:
180            SSHCommandError: 命令执行失败时抛出
181            SSHConnectionError: 未连接时抛出
182        """
183        conn = await self._get_conn()
184        env_str = ""
185        if environment:
186            env_str = "; ".join(f"export {k}={v}" for k, v in environment.items()) + "; "
187        full_command = f"{env_str}cd ~ && {command}"
188        logger.debug(f"执行命令: {command}")
189        try:
190            result = await conn.run(
191                full_command,
192                timeout=timeout,
193                check=False,
194                env={k: str(v) for k, v in (environment or {}).items()},
195            )
196        except (OSError, asyncssh.Error) as e:
197            raise SSHCommandError(f"执行命令 '{command}' 失败: {e}") from e
198
199        stdout_data = result.stdout if isinstance(result.stdout, str) else (
200            result.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if result.stdout else ""
201        )
202        stderr_data = result.stderr if isinstance(result.stderr, str) else (
203            result.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if result.stderr else ""
204        )
205        exit_code = int(result.exit_status) if result.exit_status is not None else -1
206
207        return CommandResult(
208            command=command,
209            stdout=stdout_data,
210            stderr=stderr_data,
211            exit_code=exit_code,
212        )

异步执行远程命令。

Args: command: 要执行的命令字符串 timeout: 命令执行超时（秒），None 表示不限 environment: 命令执行前注入的环境变量

Returns: CommandResult: 命令结果（与同步实现字段一致）

Raises: SSHCommandError: 命令执行失败时抛出 SSHConnectionError: 未连接时抛出

async def execute_sudo( self, command: str, password: str | None = None, timeout: int | None = None) -> remote_cmd.core.ssh_client.CommandResult: 
214    async def execute_sudo(
215        self,
216        command: str,
217        password: Optional[str] = None,
218        timeout: Optional[int] = None,
219    ) -> CommandResult:
220        """以 sudo 权限异步执行命令（安全实现：密码通过 stdin 传入，不进入进程列表）。"""
221        conn = await self._get_conn()
222        if password is None:
223            return await self.execute(f"sudo {command}", timeout=timeout)
224
225        try:
226            proc: asyncssh.SSHClientProcess = await conn.create_process(
227                f"sudo -S {command}",
228                timeout=timeout,
229            )
230        except (OSError, asyncssh.Error) as e:
231            raise SSHCommandError(f"执行 sudo 命令 '{command}' 失败: {e}") from e
232
233        try:
234            proc.stdin.write(password + "\n")
235            proc.stdin.write_eof()
236            result = await proc.wait()
237        except (OSError, asyncssh.Error) as e:
238            raise SSHCommandError(f"执行 sudo 命令 '{command}' 失败: {e}") from e
239
240        stdout_data = (
241            result.stdout if isinstance(result.stdout, str)
242            else (result.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if result.stdout else "")
243        )
244        stderr_data = (
245            result.stderr if isinstance(result.stderr, str)
246            else (result.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if result.stderr else "")
247        )
248        return CommandResult(
249            command=command,
250            stdout=stdout_data,
251            stderr=stderr_data,
252            exit_code=int(result.exit_status) if result.exit_status is not None else -1,
253        )

以 sudo 权限异步执行命令（安全实现：密码通过 stdin 传入，不进入进程列表）。

async def list_remote_directory(self, remote_path: str = '.') -> list[dict[str, typing.Any]]: 
292    async def list_remote_directory(self, remote_path: str = ".") -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
293        """异步列出远程目录内容（结构与同步 SSHClient 一致）。"""
294        sftp = await self._get_sftp()
295        try:
296            names = await sftp.readdir(remote_path)
297        except (OSError, asyncssh.Error) as e:
298            raise SSHFileTransferError(f"列出远程目录失败: {e}") from e
299
300        entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
301        for entry in names:
302            attrs = entry.attrs
303            mode = attrs.permissions if hasattr(attrs, "permissions") else None
304            entries.append(
305                {
306                    "name": entry.filename,
307                    "size": attrs.size if hasattr(attrs, "size") else 0,
308                    "mode": oct(int(mode))[-3:] if mode else "000",
309                    "mtime": attrs.mtime if hasattr(attrs, "mtime") else 0,
310                    "is_dir": bool(mode & stat.S_IFDIR) if mode else False,
311                }
312            )
313        return entries

class AsyncConnectionPool: 
 28class AsyncConnectionPool:
 29    """原生异步 SSH 连接池。
 30
 31    Args:
 32        config: 用于建立 SSH 连接的配置
 33        max_connections: 同一最大连接数（同一配置可复用）
 34        max_lifetime: 连接最大生命周期（秒），超过自动关闭
 35        idle_timeout: 空闲超时（秒），超过自动关闭
 36        health_check_interval: 后台清理任务周期（秒）
 37    """
 38
 39    def __init__(
 40        self,
 41        config: ConnectionConfig,
 42        max_connections: int = 10,
 43        max_lifetime: int = 3600,
 44        idle_timeout: int = 300,
 45        health_check_interval: int = 60,
 46    ) -> None:
 47        self.config = config
 48        self._max = max_connections
 49        self._max_lifetime = max_lifetime
 50        self._idle_timeout = idle_timeout
 51        self._health_check_interval = health_check_interval
 52
 53        # 容器
 54        self._connections: list[AsyncSSHClient] = []
 55        self._free: asyncio.Queue[AsyncSSHClient] = asyncio.Queue()
 56        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_connections)
 57        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
 58
 59        # 指标
 60        self._total_created = 0
 61        self._total_reconnects = 0
 62        self._total_failed = 0
 63        self._total_released = 0
 64
 65        # 后台清理任务
 66        self._monitor_task: Optional[asyncio.Task[None]] = None
 67
 68        # 连接元数据（副表，避免侵入 AsyncSSHClient 私有属性）
 69        self._meta: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {}
 70
 71    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
 72    # 指标
 73    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
 74    def get_metrics(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
 75        """获取连接池指标快照。"""
 76        return {
 77            "active": self._total_created - self._total_released,
 78            "idle": self._free.qsize(),
 79            "total_connections": len(self._connections),
 80            "total_created": self._total_created,
 81            "reconnects": self._total_reconnects,
 82            "failed": self._total_failed,
 83            "max_connections": self._max,
 84            "max_lifetime": self._max_lifetime,
 85            "idle_timeout": self._idle_timeout,
 86        }
 87
 88    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
 89    # 获取 / 释放
 90    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
 91    async def acquire(self) -> AsyncSSHClient:
 92        """从池中获取一个可用连接，必要时创建新连接。
 93
 94        Returns:
 95            AsyncSSHClient: 可用的异步客户端
 96
 97        Raises:
 98            SSHConnectionError: 创建连接失败
 99        """
100        await self._semaphore.acquire()
101        try:
102            # 优先复用空闲连接
103            while not self._free.empty():
104                conn = self._free.get_nowait()
105                if await self._check_connection(conn):
106                    self._touch(conn)
107                    return conn
108                await self._close_connection(conn)
109
110            # 创建新连接（信号量已保证未超额）
111            return await self._create_connection()
112        except BaseException:
113            self._semaphore.release()
114            raise
115
116    async def release(self, conn: Optional[AsyncSSHClient]) -> None:
117        """归还连接到池中（如已断开/超时则关闭）。"""
118        if conn is None:
119            return
120        meta = self._meta.get(id(conn))
121        if meta is not None:
122            meta["last_used"] = time.time()
123
124        if not conn.is_connected():
125            await self._close_connection(conn)
126            self._semaphore.release()
127            return
128
129        # 生命周期 / 空闲超时则关闭
130        if meta and (
131            time.time() - meta["created_at"] > self._max_lifetime
132            or time.time() - meta["last_used"] > self._idle_timeout
133        ):
134            await self._close_connection(conn)
135            self._semaphore.release()
136            return
137
138        try:
139            self._free.put_nowait(conn)
140            # 放回 free 后释放许可：free 中的连接不再占用并发槽位，
141            # 后续 acquire 会从 free 直接复用（无需再次获取许可）
142            self._semaphore.release()
143        except asyncio.QueueFull:
144            await self._close_connection(conn)
145            self._semaphore.release()
146        finally:
147            self._total_released += 1
148
149    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
150    # 内部
151    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
152    async def _create_connection(self) -> AsyncSSHClient:
153        client = AsyncSSHClient(self.config)
154        try:
155            await client.connect()
156        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
157            self._total_failed += 1
158            self._semaphore.release()
159            raise
160        self._connections.append(client)
161        now = time.time()
162        self._meta[id(client)] = {
163            "created_at": now,
164            "last_used": now,
165            "conn_id": uuid.uuid4().hex,
166        }
167        self._total_created += 1
168        return client
169
170    def _touch(self, conn: AsyncSSHClient) -> None:
171        meta = self._meta.get(id(conn))
172        if meta is not None:
173            meta["last_used"] = time.time()
174
175    async def _check_connection(self, conn: AsyncSSHClient) -> bool:
176        if not conn.is_connected():
177            return False
178        meta = self._meta.get(id(conn))
179        if meta is None:
180            return True
181        age = time.time() - meta["created_at"]
182        if age > self._max_lifetime:
183            logger.debug("连接 %s 已超过最大生命周期", meta.get("conn_id", "?")[:8])
184            return False
185        # 触发轻量探活：发出一个无害命令
186        try:
187            result = await conn.execute("true", timeout=5)
188            return result.success
189        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
190            self._total_reconnects += 1
191            logger.debug("连接探活失败: %s", e)
192            return False
193
194    async def _close_connection(self, conn: AsyncSSHClient) -> None:
195        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
196            await conn.disconnect()
197        self._meta.pop(id(conn), None)
198        if conn in self._connections:
199            self._connections.remove(conn)
200
201    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
202    # 后台监控
203    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
204    def _start_monitor(self) -> None:
205        if self._monitor_task is None or self._monitor_task.done():
206            self._monitor_task = asyncio.create_task(self._monitor_loop())
207
208    def stop_monitor(self) -> None:
209        if self._monitor_task and not self._monitor_task.done():
210            self._monitor_task.cancel()
211
212    async def _monitor_loop(self) -> None:
213        while True:
214            try:
215                await asyncio.sleep(self._health_check_interval)
216                await self._cleanup_expired()
217            except asyncio.CancelledError:
218                break
219            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
220                logger.warning("连接池监控异常")
221
222    async def _cleanup_expired(self) -> None:
223        now = time.time()
224        kept: asyncio.Queue[AsyncSSHClient] = asyncio.Queue()
225        while not self._free.empty():
226            conn = self._free.get_nowait()
227            meta = self._meta.get(id(conn))
228            if meta is None:
229                await self._close_connection(conn)
230                continue
231            age = now - meta["created_at"]
232            idle = now - meta["last_used"]
233            if age < self._max_lifetime and idle < self._idle_timeout and conn.is_connected():
234                await kept.put(conn)
235            else:
236                await self._close_connection(conn)
237        self._free = kept
238
239    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
240    # 上下文管理
241    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
242    class _AcquireContext:
243        def __init__(self, pool: "AsyncConnectionPool") -> None:
244            self._pool = pool
245            self._conn: Optional[AsyncSSHClient] = None
246
247        async def __aenter__(self) -> AsyncSSHClient:
248            self._conn = await self._pool.acquire()
249            return self._conn
250
251        async def __aexit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb) -> None:
252            await self._pool.release(self._conn)
253            self._conn = None
254
255    def acquire_context(self) -> "_AcquireContext":
256        """获取连接的上下文管理器。"""
257        return AsyncConnectionPool._AcquireContext(self)
258
259    async def close_all(self) -> None:
260        """关闭池中所有连接并停止监控。"""
261        self.stop_monitor()
262        for conn in list(self._connections):
263            await self._close_connection(conn)
264        # 释放所有信号量
265        while self._free.empty() is False:
266            self._free.get_nowait()
267
268    async def __aenter__(self) -> "AsyncConnectionPool":
269        self._start_monitor()
270        return self
271
272    async def __aexit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb) -> None:
273        await self.close_all()

 37class AsyncBatchExecutor:
 38    """异步批量命令执行器。
 39
 40    Args:
 41        host_service: HostService 实例（提供主机配置与凭据解析）
 42        max_concurrency: 最大并发主机数，默认 10
 43        command_timeout: 单条命令超时（秒），默认 30
 44    """
 45
 46    def __init__(
 47        self,
 48        host_service: HostService,
 49        max_concurrency: int = 10,
 50        command_timeout: int = 30,
 51    ) -> None:
 52        self._host_service = host_service
 53        self._max_concurrency = max_concurrency
 54        self._command_timeout = command_timeout
 55
 56    async def execute(
 57        self,
 58        host_names: list[str],
 59        command: str,
 60        retry_count: int = 0,
 61        retry_delay: float = 1.0,
 62        progress_callback: Optional[ProgressCallback] = None,
 63    ) -> BatchResult:
 64        """在多台主机上异步并发执行同一命令。
 65
 66        Args:
 67            host_names: 主机名称列表
 68            command: 要执行的命令
 69            retry_count: 失败重试次数（默认 0）
 70            retry_delay: 重试间隔（秒）
 71            progress_callback: 进度回调，签名为 `(completed, total, host_name)`；
 72                回调可为同步或 async 函数（async 时会被 await）。
 73
 74        Returns:
 75            BatchResult: 批量结果（与同步 BatchExecutor 完全一致）
 76
 77        Raises:
 78            ValueError: host_names 为空
 79        """
 80        if not host_names:
 81            raise ValueError("主机列表不能为空")
 82
 83        total = len(host_names)
 84        semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(self._max_concurrency)
 85        start = time.time()
 86
 87        logger.info(
 88            "异步批量执行开始: %s 台主机, 并发=%s, 命令='%s'",
 89            total, self._max_concurrency, command,
 90        )
 91
 92        completed_counter = 0
 93        completed_lock = asyncio.Lock()
 94        results: dict[str, BatchHostResult] = {}
 95
 96        async def _per_host(name: str) -> None:
 97            nonlocal completed_counter
 98            async with semaphore:
 99                result = await self._execute_on_host(name, command, retry_count, retry_delay)
100            async with completed_lock:
101                results[name] = result
102                completed = completed_counter + 1
103                completed_counter = completed
104
105                if progress_callback is not None:
106                    rv = progress_callback(completed, total, name)
107                    if asyncio.iscoroutine(rv):
108                        await rv
109
110                logger.debug(
111                    "[%s/%s] %s: %s (%.1fs)",
112                    completed, total, name,
113                    "✓" if result.success else "✗",
114                    result.duration,
115                )
116
117        tasks = [asyncio.create_task(_per_host(n)) for n in host_names]
118        try:
119            await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
120        except KeyboardInterrupt:
121            logger.warning("用户中断批量执行")
122            await self._cancel_and_mark_interrupted(tasks, host_names, results, command)
123
124        duration = time.time() - start
125        success_count = sum(1 for r in results.values() if r.success)
126        failed_count = total - success_count
127        logger.info("异步批量执行完成: %s/%s 成功, 耗时 %.1fs", success_count, total, duration)
128
129        return BatchResult(
130            total=total,
131            success=success_count,
132            failed=failed_count,
133            duration=duration,
134            results=results,
135        )
136
137    async def _cancel_and_mark_interrupted(
138        self,
139        tasks: list[asyncio.Task],
140        host_names: list[str],
141        results: dict[str, BatchHostResult],
142        command: str,
143    ) -> None:
144        """用户中断时取消所有任务，并为未完成主机创建失败记录。"""
145        for t in tasks:
146            t.cancel()
147        # 等待取消完成，避免 pending task 告警
148        await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
149        # 为尚未有结果的主机创建失败记录
150        for name in host_names:
151            if name not in results:
152                results[name] = BatchHostResult(
153                    host=name,
154                    success=False,
155                    command=command,
156                    error="用户中断",
157                )
158
159    async def _execute_on_host(
160        self,
161        host_name: str,
162        command: str,
163        retry_count: int,
164        retry_delay: float,
165    ) -> BatchHostResult:
166        """在单台主机上异步执行命令（含重试逻辑）。"""
167        # 主机解析
168        try:
169            host: Host = self._host_service.resolve_host(host_name)
170        except KeyError as e:
171            return BatchHostResult(
172                host=host_name, success=False, command=command,
173                error=f"主机不存在: {e}",
174            )
175        except (RuntimeError, OSError) as e:
176            return BatchHostResult(
177                host=host_name, success=False, command=command,
178                error=f"主机解析失败: {e}",
179            )
180
181        last_error: Optional[str] = None
182        for attempt in range(retry_count + 1):
183            start = time.time()
184            try:
185                config = ConnectionConfig(
186                    hostname=host.hostname,
187                    username=host.username,
188                    port=host.port,
189                    password=host.password,
190                    key_filename=host.key_filename,
191                    timeout=self._command_timeout,
192                )
193                async with AsyncSSHClient(config) as client:
194                    cmd_result = await client.execute(
195                        command, timeout=self._command_timeout,
196                    )
197                duration = time.time() - start
198                return BatchHostResult(
199                    host=host_name,
200                    success=cmd_result.success,
201                    command=command,
202                    stdout=cmd_result.stdout,
203                    stderr=cmd_result.stderr,
204                    exit_code=cmd_result.exit_code,
205                    duration=duration,
206                )
207            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
208                last_error = str(e)
209                logger.debug(
210                    "%s 第 %s/%s 次尝试失败: %s",
211                    host_name, attempt + 1, retry_count + 1, e,
212                )
213                if attempt < retry_count:
214                    await asyncio.sleep(retry_delay)
215
216        return BatchHostResult(
217            host=host_name, success=False, command=command,
218            error=last_error, duration=0.0,
219        )

异步批量命令执行器。

Args: host_service: HostService 实例（提供主机配置与凭据解析） max_concurrency: 最大并发主机数，默认 10 command_timeout: 单条命令超时（秒），默认 30

AsyncBatchExecutor( host_service: HostService, max_concurrency: int = 10, command_timeout: int = 30) 
46    def __init__(
47        self,
48        host_service: HostService,
49        max_concurrency: int = 10,
50        command_timeout: int = 30,
51    ) -> None:
52        self._host_service = host_service
53        self._max_concurrency = max_concurrency
54        self._command_timeout = command_timeout
async def execute( self, host_names: list[str], command: str, retry_count: int = 0, retry_delay: float = 1.0, progress_callback: Callable[[int, int, str], Awaitable[None] | None] | None = None) -> BatchResult: 
 56    async def execute(
 57        self,
 58        host_names: list[str],
 59        command: str,
 60        retry_count: int = 0,
 61        retry_delay: float = 1.0,
 62        progress_callback: Optional[ProgressCallback] = None,
 63    ) -> BatchResult:
 64        """在多台主机上异步并发执行同一命令。
 65
 66        Args:
 67            host_names: 主机名称列表
 68            command: 要执行的命令
 69            retry_count: 失败重试次数（默认 0）
 70            retry_delay: 重试间隔（秒）
 71            progress_callback: 进度回调，签名为 `(completed, total, host_name)`；
 72                回调可为同步或 async 函数（async 时会被 await）。
 73
 74        Returns:
 75            BatchResult: 批量结果（与同步 BatchExecutor 完全一致）
 76
 77        Raises:
 78            ValueError: host_names 为空
 79        """
 80        if not host_names:
 81            raise ValueError("主机列表不能为空")
 82
 83        total = len(host_names)
 84        semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(self._max_concurrency)
 85        start = time.time()
 86
 87        logger.info(
 88            "异步批量执行开始: %s 台主机, 并发=%s, 命令='%s'",
 89            total, self._max_concurrency, command,
 90        )
 91
 92        completed_counter = 0
 93        completed_lock = asyncio.Lock()
 94        results: dict[str, BatchHostResult] = {}
 95
 96        async def _per_host(name: str) -> None:
 97            nonlocal completed_counter
 98            async with semaphore:
 99                result = await self._execute_on_host(name, command, retry_count, retry_delay)
100            async with completed_lock:
101                results[name] = result
102                completed = completed_counter + 1
103                completed_counter = completed
104
105                if progress_callback is not None:
106                    rv = progress_callback(completed, total, name)
107                    if asyncio.iscoroutine(rv):
108                        await rv
109
110                logger.debug(
111                    "[%s/%s] %s: %s (%.1fs)",
112                    completed, total, name,
113                    "✓" if result.success else "✗",
114                    result.duration,
115                )
116
117        tasks = [asyncio.create_task(_per_host(n)) for n in host_names]
118        try:
119            await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
120        except KeyboardInterrupt:
121            logger.warning("用户中断批量执行")
122            await self._cancel_and_mark_interrupted(tasks, host_names, results, command)
123
124        duration = time.time() - start
125        success_count = sum(1 for r in results.values() if r.success)
126        failed_count = total - success_count
127        logger.info("异步批量执行完成: %s/%s 成功, 耗时 %.1fs", success_count, total, duration)
128
129        return BatchResult(
130            total=total,
131            success=success_count,
132            failed=failed_count,
133            duration=duration,
134            results=results,
135        )

 26class HostManager:
 27    """
 28    主机管理器（向后兼容版本）
 29
 30    保持原有 API 签名不变，内部委托给 HostService + JsonHostRepository。
 31
 32    已弃用: 请使用 HostService + HostRepository 替代
 33    """
 34
 35    def __init__(self, hosts_file: Optional[str] = None):
 36        """
 37        初始化主机管理器
 38
 39        Args:
 40            hosts_file: 配置文件路径（可选）
 41        """
 42        self.hosts_file = hosts_file
 43
 44        # 不指定文件时使用纯内存模式（保持向后兼容）
 45        if hosts_file:
 46            self._repo = JsonHostRepository(filepath=hosts_file, auto_load=True)
 47        else:
 48            self._repo = JsonHostRepository(filepath="hosts.json", auto_load=False)
 49
 50        self._service = HostService(repository=self._repo)
 51
 52        # 保持原有属性访问兼容
 53        self.hosts: dict[str, Host] = {}
 54        self._sync_hosts()
 55
 56    def _sync_hosts(self):
 57        """同步 self.hosts 字典以保持向后兼容"""
 58        self.hosts = {h.name: h for h in self._repo.list()}
 59
 60    # ========================================================================
 61    # 主机管理方法
 62    # ========================================================================
 63
 64    def add_host(self, host: Host) -> None:
 65        self._service.add_host(host)
 66        self._sync_hosts()
 67
 68    def update_host(self, name: str, **kwargs) -> Host:
 69        host = self._service.update_host(name, **kwargs)
 70        self._sync_hosts()
 71        return host
 72
 73    def remove_host(self, name: str) -> None:
 74        self._service.remove_host(name)
 75        self._sync_hosts()
 76
 77    def get_host(self, name: str) -> Host:
 78        return self._service.get_host(name)
 79
 80    def list_hosts(self, tag: Optional[str] = None) -> list[Host]:
 81        return self._service.list_hosts(tag=tag)
 82
 83    def list_tags(self) -> list[str]:
 84        return self._service.list_tags()
 85
 86    # ========================================================================
 87    # 持久化方法
 88    # ========================================================================
 89
 90    def save_to_file(self, filepath: str) -> None:
 91        """
 92        保存配置到文件
 93
 94        注意: JsonHostRepository 使用 atomic write。
 95        如果 filepath 与初始化时的不同，会更新 repo 的路径。
 96        """
 97        from pathlib import Path
 98
 99        current_path = str(self._repo._filepath)
100        if Path(current_path) != Path(filepath):
101            # 重新初始化 repo
102            self._repo = JsonHostRepository(filepath=filepath, auto_load=False)
103            self._repo.load_from_dict({h.name: h for h in self._service.list_hosts()})
104        self._repo.flush()
105        self._sync_hosts()
106
107    def load_from_file(self, filepath: str) -> None:
108        """从文件加载配置"""
109        self._repo = JsonHostRepository(filepath=filepath, auto_load=True)
110        self._service = HostService(repository=self._repo)
111        self._sync_hosts()
112
113    # ========================================================================
114    # 连接测试方法
115    # ========================================================================
116
117    def connect_to_host(self, name: str) -> SSHClient:
118        return self._service.connect_to_host(name)
119
120    def test_connection(self, name: str) -> bool:
121        """测试主机连接（通过 connect_to_host 保持 monkeypatch 兼容）"""
122        try:
123            with self.connect_to_host(name) as client:
124                return client.is_connected()
125        except OSError as e:
126            logger.error(f"主机 {name} 连接测试失败: {e}")
127            return False
128
129    def test_all_connections(self, max_workers: int = 10) -> dict[str, bool]:
130        """并行测试所有主机（通过 test_connection 保持 monkeypatch 兼容）"""
131        results: dict[str, bool] = {}
132        host_names = list(self.hosts.keys())
133
134        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as executor:
135            future_map = {executor.submit(self.test_connection, name): name for name in host_names}
136            for future in as_completed(future_map):
137                name = future_map[future]
138                try:
139                    results[name] = future.result()
140                except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
141                    logger.error(f"主机 {name} 连接测试异常: {e}")
142                    results[name] = False
143
144        return results
145
146    # ========================================================================
147    # 魔术方法
148    # ========================================================================
149
150    def __enter__(self) -> "HostManager":
151        return self
152
153    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb) -> None:
154        pass
155
156    def __len__(self) -> int:
157        return self._repo.count()
158
159    def __contains__(self, name: str) -> bool:
160        return self._repo.contains(name)

 20class Host:
 21    """
 22    远程主机配置类
 23
 24    存储单个远程主机的所有连接信息和元数据。
 25    支持通过标签进行分类管理。
 26
 27    Attributes:
 28        name: 主机名称（唯一标识符）
 29        hostname: 主机地址（IP 或域名）
 30        username: SSH 登录用户名
 31        port: SSH 端口号，默认为 22
 32        password: 登录密码（可选，可能被加密）
 33        key_filename: SSH 私钥文件路径（可选）
 34        tags: 主机标签列表，用于分类和筛选
 35        description: 主机描述信息
 36
 37    Example:
 38        >>> host = Host(
 39        ...     name="web-server",
 40        ...     hostname="192.168.1.100",
 41        ...     username="admin",
 42        ...     key_filename="~/.ssh/id_rsa",
 43        ...     tags=["production", "web"]
 44        ... )
 45    """
 46
 47    name: str
 48    hostname: str
 49    username: str
 50    port: int = 22
 51    password: Optional[str] = None
 52    key_filename: Optional[str] = None
 53    tags: Optional[list[str]] = None
 54    description: str = ""
 55
 56    def __post_init__(self):
 57        """初始化后处理：设置默认标签列表"""
 58        if self.tags is None:
 59            self.tags = []
 60
 61    def to_connection_config(self) -> ConnectionConfig:
 62        """
 63        将主机配置转换为 SSH 连接配置
 64
 65        Returns:
 66            ConnectionConfig: 可直接用于 SSHClient 的连接配置对象
 67        """
 68        return ConnectionConfig(
 69            hostname=self.hostname,
 70            username=self.username,
 71            port=self.port,
 72            password=self.password,
 73            key_filename=self.key_filename,
 74        )
 75
 76    def to_dict(self) -> dict:
 77        """
 78        将主机配置转换为字典
 79
 80        Returns:
 81            Dict: 包含所有主机属性的字典
 82        """
 83        return asdict(self)
 84
 85    @classmethod
 86    def from_dict(cls, data: dict) -> "Host":
 87        """
 88        从字典创建主机配置对象
 89
 90        Args:
 91            data: 包含主机属性的字典
 92
 93        Returns:
 94            Host: 主机配置对象
 95        """
 96        # 只提取 Host 已知的字段，忽略未知字段
 97        known_fields = {
 98            "name",
 99            "hostname",
100            "username",
101            "port",
102            "password",
103            "key_filename",
104            "tags",
105            "description",
106        }
107        filtered = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k in known_fields}
108        return cls(**filtered)

 91            data: 包含主机属性的字典
 92
 93        Returns:
 94            Host: 主机配置对象
 95        """
 96        # 只提取 Host 已知的字段，忽略未知字段
 97        known_fields = {
 98            "name",
 99            "hostname",
100            "username",
101            "port",
102            "password",
103            "key_filename",
104            "tags",
105            "description",
106        }
107        filtered = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k in known_fields}
108        return cls(**filtered)

Returns: Host: 主机配置对象
