class JsonHostRepository(remote_cmd.HostRepository): 
 31class JsonHostRepository(HostRepository):
 32    """
 33    JSON 文件主机仓库
 34
 35    Args:
 36        filepath: JSON 文件路径
 37        encryption: 可选的凭据加密器（设置后自动加密 password）
 38        auto_load: 初始化时是否自动加载已有文件（默认 True）
 39    """
 40
 41    def __init__(
 42        self,
 43        filepath: str,
 44        encryption: Optional[CredentialEncryption] = None,
 45        auto_load: bool = True,
 46    ):
 47        self._filepath = Path(filepath)
 48        self._encryption = encryption
 49        self._hosts: dict[str, Host] = {}
 50
 51        if auto_load and self._filepath.exists():
 52            self._load()
 53
 54    # ========================================================================
 55    # Repository 接口实现
 56    # ========================================================================
 57
 58    def save(self, host: Host) -> None:
 59        """保存主机到内存，随后需要调用 flush() 写入文件"""
 60        self._hosts[host.name] = host
 61
 62    def get(self, name: str) -> Host:
 63        if name not in self._hosts:
 64            raise KeyError(f"主机 '{name}' 不存在")
 65        return self._hosts[name]
 66
 67    def delete(self, name: str) -> None:
 68        if name not in self._hosts:
 69            raise KeyError(f"主机 '{name}' 不存在")
 70        del self._hosts[name]
 71
 72    def list(self, tag: Optional[str] = None) -> list[Host]:
 73        hosts = list(self._hosts.values())
 74        if tag:
 75            hosts = [h for h in hosts if h.tags and tag in h.tags]
 76        return hosts
 77
 78    def list_tags(self) -> builtins.list[str]:
 79        tags: set = set()
 80        for host in self._hosts.values():
 81            if host.tags:
 82                tags.update(host.tags)
 83        return sorted(tags)
 84
 85    def contains(self, name: str) -> bool:
 86        return name in self._hosts
 87
 88    def count(self) -> int:
 89        return len(self._hosts)
 90
 91    # ========================================================================
 92    # 持久化
 93    # ========================================================================
 94
 95    def flush(self) -> None:
 96        """原子写入 JSON 文件"""
 97        data = self._serialize_hosts()
 98        self._atomic_write(data)
 99
100    def _serialize_hosts(self) -> dict:
101        """序列化主机列表到字典，包含版本信息"""
102        hosts_dict = {name: host.to_dict() for name, host in self._hosts.items()}
103
104        # 加密密码
105        if self._encryption:
106            for host_data in hosts_dict.values():
107                pw = host_data.get("password")
108                if pw and not self._encryption.is_encrypted(pw):
109                    host_data["password"] = self._encryption.encrypt(pw)
110
111        return {
112            "version": CONFIG_VERSION,
113            "hosts": hosts_dict,
114        }
115
116    def _load(self) -> None:
117        """从 JSON 文件加载主机配置"""
118        try:
119            with open(self._filepath, encoding="utf-8") as f:
120                raw = json.load(f)
121        except (json.JSONDecodeError, FileNotFoundError) as e:
122            logger.warning(f"加载配置文件失败: {e}")
123            return
124
125        # 检查版本并迁移
126        version = raw.get("version", 1)
127        if version < CONFIG_VERSION:
128            logger.info(f"配置版本 {version} -> {CONFIG_VERSION}，执行迁移")
129
130        hosts_data = raw.get("hosts", raw if version == 1 else {})
131        # 兼容 v1 格式（hosts 直接在最外层）
132        if version == 1 and isinstance(hosts_data, dict):
133            pass  # hosts_data 已经是正确的格式
134
135        self._hosts = {}
136        for name, host_data in hosts_data.items():
137            pw = host_data.get("password")
138            if pw and self._encryption and self._encryption.is_encrypted(pw):
139                try:
140                    host_data["password"] = self._encryption.decrypt(pw)
141                except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, CredentialEncryptionError) as e:
142                    logger.error(f"解密主机 '{name}' 密码失败: {e}")
143                    host_data["password"] = None
144
145            try:
146                host = Host.from_dict(host_data)
147                self._hosts[name] = host
148            except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as e:
149                logger.warning(f"跳过无效主机 '{name}': {e}")
150
151    def _atomic_write(self, data: dict) -> None:
152        """原子写入：写临时文件 → rename 覆盖原文件"""
153        self._filepath.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
154
155        fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(
156            suffix=".tmp",
157            prefix=f"{self._filepath.name}.",
158            dir=self._filepath.parent,
159        )
160        try:
161            with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
162                json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
163            os.replace(tmp_path, str(self._filepath))
164        except Exception:
165            # 清理临时文件
166            with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
167                os.unlink(tmp_path)
168            raise
169
170        logger.debug(f"已保存 {self.count()} 个主机配置到 {self._filepath}")
171
172    # ========================================================================
173    # 批量操作
174    # ========================================================================
175
176    def load_from_dict(self, data: dict[str, Host]) -> None:
177        """从字典批量加载主机（替换当前所有）"""
178        self._hosts = dict(data)
179
180    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Host]:
181        """导出所有主机的字典"""
182        return dict(self._hosts)

class HostService: 
 45class HostService:
 46    """
 47    主机业务逻辑服务
 48
 49    Args:
 50        repository: 主机配置仓库
 51        credential_provider: 凭据提供者（可选）
 52        encryption: 密码加密器（可选）
 53        ssh_service: SSH 连接服务（可选，自动创建）
 54    """
 55
 56    def __init__(
 57        self,
 58        repository: HostRepository,
 59        credential_provider: Optional[CredentialProvider] = None,
 60        encryption: Optional[CredentialEncryption] = None,
 61        ssh_service: Optional[SSHService] = None,
 62    ):
 63        self._repo = repository
 64        self._encryption = encryption or CredentialEncryption()
 65        self._ssh = ssh_service or SSHService()
 66
 67        if credential_provider:
 68            self._cred_provider = credential_provider
 69        else:
 70            # 默认凭据链: 环境变量 → 加密文件
 71            self._cred_provider = ChainCredentialProvider(
 72                [
 73                    EnvCredentialProvider(),
 74                    EncryptedFileCredentialProvider(repository, self._encryption),
 75                ]
 76            )
 77
 78    # ========================================================================
 79    # 主机管理
 80    # ========================================================================
 81
 82    def add_host(self, host: Host) -> Host:
 83        """
 84        添加主机
 85
 86        Args:
 87            host: 主机配置
 88
 89        Returns:
 90            Host: 已添加的主机
 91
 92        Raises:
 93            ValueError: 同名主机已存在
 94        """
 95        if self._repo.contains(host.name):
 96            raise ValueError(f"主机 '{host.name}' 已存在")
 97
 98        # 加密密码（如果明文）
 99        if host.password and not self._encryption.is_encrypted(host.password):
100            host.password = self._encryption.encrypt(host.password)
101
102        self._repo.save(host)
103        self._repo.flush()
104        logger.info(f"已添加主机: {host.name}")
105        return host
106
107    def get_host(self, name: str) -> Host:
108        """获取主机配置（密码自动解密）"""
109        host = self._repo.get(name)
110        return self._decrypt_host(host)
111
112    def update_host(self, name: str, **kwargs) -> Host:
113        """
114        更新主机配置
115
116        Args:
117            name: 主机名
118            **kwargs: 要更新的字段
119
120        Returns:
121            Host: 更新后的主机
122        """
123        host = self._repo.get(name)
124        for key, value in kwargs.items():
125            if hasattr(host, key):
126                setattr(host, key, value)
127
128        # 如果密码被更新，重新加密
129        if (
130            "password" in kwargs
131            and kwargs["password"] is not None
132            and not self._encryption.is_encrypted(kwargs["password"])
133        ):
134            host.password = self._encryption.encrypt(kwargs["password"])
135
136        self._repo.save(host)
137        self._repo.flush()
138        logger.info(f"已更新主机: {name}")
139        return host
140
141    def remove_host(self, name: str) -> None:
142        """删除主机"""
143        self._repo.delete(name)
144        self._repo.flush()
145        logger.info(f"已删除主机: {name}")
146
147    def list_hosts(self, tag: Optional[str] = None) -> list[Host]:
148        """列出主机（密码自动解密）"""
149        hosts = self._repo.list(tag=tag)
150        return [self._decrypt_host(h) for h in hosts]
151
152    def list_tags(self) -> list[str]:
153        """列出所有标签"""
154        return self._repo.list_tags()
155
156    # ========================================================================
157    # 连接管理
158    # ========================================================================
159
160    def connect_to_host(self, name: str) -> SSHClient:
161        """
162        建立到主机的 SSH 连接
163
164        Args:
165            name: 主机名
166
167        Returns:
168            SSHClient: 已连接的客户端
169        """
170        host = self.resolve_host(name)
171        client = self._ssh.create_client(
172            hostname=host.hostname,
173            username=host.username,
174            port=host.port,
175            password=host.password,
176            key_filename=host.key_filename,
177        )
178        return client
179
180    def test_connection(self, name: str) -> bool:
181        """
182        测试主机连接
183
184        Args:
185            name: 主机名
186
187        Returns:
188            bool: 连接成功返回 True
189        """
190        host = self.resolve_host(name)
191        return self._ssh.test_connection(
192            hostname=host.hostname,
193            username=host.username,
194            port=host.port,
195            password=host.password,
196            key_filename=host.key_filename,
197        )
198
199    def test_all_connections(self, max_workers: int = 10) -> dict[str, bool]:
200        """并行测试所有主机连接"""
201        from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
202
203        hosts = self._repo.list()
204        results: dict[str, bool] = {}
205
206        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as executor:
207            future_map = {executor.submit(self.test_connection, h.name): h.name for h in hosts}
208            for future in as_completed(future_map):
209                name = future_map[future]
210                try:
211                    results[name] = future.result()
212                except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
213                    logger.error(f"主机 {name} 连接测试异常: {e}")
214                    results[name] = False
215
216        return results
217
218    def _decrypt_host(self, host: Host) -> Host:
219        """返回主机副本，密码字段自动解密（如已加密）"""
220        if host.password and self._encryption.is_encrypted(host.password):
221            try:
222                decrypted = self._encryption.decrypt(host.password)
223                return Host(
224                    name=host.name,
225                    hostname=host.hostname,
226                    username=host.username,
227                    port=host.port,
228                    password=decrypted,
229                    key_filename=host.key_filename,
230                    tags=host.tags,
231                    description=host.description,
232                )
233            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
234                logger.warning(f"密码解密失败 ({host.name}): {e}")
235        return host
236
237    def resolve_host(self, name: str) -> Host:
238        """
239        获取主机并尝试解密密码
240
241        解密优先级：
242        1. 通过凭据提供链（环境变量 / keyring / 加密文件存储等）获取明文
243        2. 若凭据链未命中，则回退到本地 CredentialEncryption 解密存储中的加密 token
244
245        这一层兜底是必需的：CLI 的默认凭据链可能不包含
246        EncryptedFileCredentialProvider，但主机密码已被 add_host 加密落盘，
247        若不兜底解密则 connect_to_host 会拿到加密 token 当密码使用，必然认证失败。
248        """
249        host = self._repo.get(name)
250
251        # 尝试通过凭据链解密密码
252        if host.password and self._encryption.is_encrypted(host.password):
253            resolved = self._cred_provider.get_password(host)
254            if resolved:
255                host.password = resolved
256            else:
257                # 凭据链未命中，回退到本地加密器解密
258                try:
259                    host.password = self._encryption.decrypt(host.password)
260                except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
261                    logger.warning(f"密码解密失败 ({host.name}): {e}")
262                    # 保留加密 token，留给 SSH 层报认证失败
263
264        # 尝试解析密钥路径
265        if host.key_filename:
266            from pathlib import Path
267
268            host.key_filename = str(Path(host.key_filename).expanduser())
269
270        return host

132            and not self._encryption.is_encrypted(kwargs["password"])
133        ):
134            host.password = self._encryption.encrypt(kwargs["password"])
135
136        self._repo.save(host)
137        self._repo.flush()
138        logger.info(f"已更新主机: {name}")
139        return host

def test_all_connections(self, max_workers: int = 10) -> dict[str, bool]: 
199    def test_all_connections(self, max_workers: int = 10) -> dict[str, bool]:
200        """并行测试所有主机连接"""
201        from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed
202
203        hosts = self._repo.list()
204        results: dict[str, bool] = {}
205
206        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as executor:
207            future_map = {executor.submit(self.test_connection, h.name): h.name for h in hosts}
208            for future in as_completed(future_map):
209                name = future_map[future]
210                try:
211                    results[name] = future.result()
212                except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
213                    logger.error(f"主机 {name} 连接测试异常: {e}")
214                    results[name] = False
215
216        return results

def resolve_host(self, name: str) -> Host: 
237    def resolve_host(self, name: str) -> Host:
238        """
239        获取主机并尝试解密密码
240
241        解密优先级：
242        1. 通过凭据提供链（环境变量 / keyring / 加密文件存储等）获取明文
243        2. 若凭据链未命中，则回退到本地 CredentialEncryption 解密存储中的加密 token
244
245        这一层兜底是必需的：CLI 的默认凭据链可能不包含
246        EncryptedFileCredentialProvider，但主机密码已被 add_host 加密落盘，
247        若不兜底解密则 connect_to_host 会拿到加密 token 当密码使用，必然认证失败。
248        """
249        host = self._repo.get(name)
250
251        # 尝试通过凭据链解密密码
252        if host.password and self._encryption.is_encrypted(host.password):
253            resolved = self._cred_provider.get_password(host)
254            if resolved:
255                host.password = resolved
256            else:
257                # 凭据链未命中，回退到本地加密器解密
258                try:
259                    host.password = self._encryption.decrypt(host.password)
260                except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
261                    logger.warning(f"密码解密失败 ({host.name}): {e}")
262                    # 保留加密 token，留给 SSH 层报认证失败
263
264        # 尝试解析密钥路径
265        if host.key_filename:
266            from pathlib import Path
267
268            host.key_filename = str(Path(host.key_filename).expanduser())
269
270        return host

获取主机并尝试解密密码

解密优先级：

  1. 通过凭据提供链（环境变量 / keyring / 加密文件存储等）获取明文
  2. 若凭据链未命中，则回退到本地 CredentialEncryption 解密存储中的加密 token

这一层兜底是必需的：CLI 的默认凭据链可能不包含 EncryptedFileCredentialProvider，但主机密码已被 add_host 加密落盘， 若不兜底解密则 connect_to_host 会拿到加密 token 当密码使用，必然认证失败。

class CredentialEncryption: 
 36class CredentialEncryption:
 37    """
 38    Fernet 凭据加解密器
 39
 40    使用 cryptography.fernet 实现对称加密。
 41    密钥自动管理：首次加密时生成，后续自动加载。
 42
 43    Attributes:
 44        key_path: 密钥文件存储路径
 45    """
 46
 47    _PREFIX = "$encrypted$"
 48
 49    def __init__(self, key_path: Optional[Path] = None):
 50        """
 51        Args:
 52            key_path: 密钥文件路径，默认 ~/.remote_cmd/.key
 53        """
 54        from cryptography.fernet import Fernet
 55
 56        self._key_path = key_path or (Path.home() / ".remote_cmd" / ".key")
 57        self._fernet: Optional[Fernet] = None
 58
 59    @property
 60    def _cipher(self):
 61        """延迟初始化 Fernet 实例"""
 62        if self._fernet is None:
 63            key = self._load_or_create_key()
 64            from cryptography.fernet import Fernet
 65
 66            self._fernet = Fernet(key)
 67        return self._fernet
 68
 69    def encrypt(self, plaintext: str) -> str:
 70        """
 71        加密明文密码
 72
 73        Args:
 74            plaintext: 明文密码
 75
 76        Returns:
 77            str: Base64 编码的密文字符串（格式: $encrypted$<token>）
 78
 79        Raises:
 80            CredentialEncryptionError: 加密失败
 81        """
 82        try:
 83            token = self._cipher.encrypt(plaintext.encode("utf-8"))
 84            return self._PREFIX + token.decode("utf-8")
 85        except Exception as e:
 86            raise CredentialEncryptionError(f"加密失败: {e}") from e
 87
 88    def decrypt(self, ciphertext: str) -> str:
 89        """
 90        解密密文
 91
 92        Args:
 93            ciphertext: 加密后的密文字符串
 94
 95        Returns:
 96            str: 明文密码
 97
 98        Raises:
 99            CredentialEncryptionError: 解密失败或格式错误
100        """
101        if not ciphertext.startswith(self._PREFIX):
102            raise CredentialEncryptionError("错误的密文格式")
103
104        try:
105            token = ciphertext[len(self._PREFIX) :].encode("utf-8")
106            return self._cipher.decrypt(token).decode("utf-8")
107        except Exception as e:
108            raise CredentialEncryptionError(f"解密失败: {e}") from e
109
110    def is_encrypted(self, value: str) -> bool:
111        """
112        检查字符串是否为加密格式
113
114        采用双重校验降低格式碰撞风险：
115        1. 前缀匹配 ``$encrypted$``
116        2. token 部分必须是 Fernet 格式（version byte 0x80，base64 编码后以 ``g`` 开头，
117           且解码后总长度至少 57 字节 = 1 + 8 + 16 + 32）
118
119        这避免了与真实密码恰好以 ``$encrypted$`` 开头时被误判的场景：
120        真实密码很少以 ``$encrypted$g`` 开头，且 base64 解码长度必须 >= 57 字节。
121
122        Attention: 本函数不验证 HMAC/签名，仅为廉价标识符检测；
123        完整合法性校验在 :meth:`decrypt` 中完成。
124        """
125        if not value.startswith(self._PREFIX):
126            return False
127        token = value[len(self._PREFIX) :]
128        # Fernet token base64 解码后第一字节恒为 0x80（编码后开头为 "g"）
129        if not token.startswith("g"):
130            return False
131        # 重新填充 base64 并解码长度校验，避免误判纯字符串
132        import base64
133
134        padding = "=" * (-len(token) % 4)
135        try:
136            decoded = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(token + padding)
137        except ValueError:
138            return False
139        # 最小密文长度 = version(1) + timestamp(8) + IV(16) + HMAC(32)
140        return len(decoded) >= 57
141
142    def _load_or_create_key(self) -> bytes:
143        """
144        加载现有密钥或生成新密钥
145
146        密钥文件权限设为 0600，防止其他用户读取。
147        """
148        from cryptography.fernet import Fernet
149
150        if self._key_path.exists():
151            # 确保现有密钥文件权限正确
152            try:
153                current_perms = stat_module.S_IMODE(self._key_path.stat().st_mode)
154                if current_perms != 0o600:
155                    self._key_path.chmod(0o600)
156            except OSError:
157                pass  # Windows 或权限不足时忽略
158            return self._key_path.read_bytes()
159
160        # 生成新密钥
161        key = Fernet.generate_key()
162        self._key_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
163        self._key_path.write_bytes(key)
164        with contextlib.suppress(OSError):
165            self._key_path.chmod(0o600)
166
167        logger.info(f"已生成加密密钥: {self._key_path}")
168        return key

Fernet 凭据加解密器

使用 cryptography.fernet 实现对称加密。 密钥自动管理：首次加密时生成，后续自动加载。

Returns: str: 明文密码

Raises: CredentialEncryptionError: 解密失败或格式错误

def is_encrypted(self, value: str) -> bool: 
110    def is_encrypted(self, value: str) -> bool:
111        """
112        检查字符串是否为加密格式
113
114        采用双重校验降低格式碰撞风险：
115        1. 前缀匹配 ``$encrypted$``
116        2. token 部分必须是 Fernet 格式（version byte 0x80，base64 编码后以 ``g`` 开头，
117           且解码后总长度至少 57 字节 = 1 + 8 + 16 + 32）
118
119        这避免了与真实密码恰好以 ``$encrypted$`` 开头时被误判的场景：
120        真实密码很少以 ``$encrypted$g`` 开头，且 base64 解码长度必须 >= 57 字节。
121
122        Attention: 本函数不验证 HMAC/签名，仅为廉价标识符检测；
123        完整合法性校验在 :meth:`decrypt` 中完成。
124        """
125        if not value.startswith(self._PREFIX):
126            return False
127        token = value[len(self._PREFIX) :]
128        # Fernet token base64 解码后第一字节恒为 0x80（编码后开头为 "g"）
129        if not token.startswith("g"):
130            return False
131        # 重新填充 base64 并解码长度校验，避免误判纯字符串
132        import base64
133
134        padding = "=" * (-len(token) % 4)
135        try:
136            decoded = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(token + padding)
137        except ValueError:
138            return False
139        # 最小密文长度 = version(1) + timestamp(8) + IV(16) + HMAC(32)
140        return len(decoded) >= 57

检查字符串是否为加密格式

采用双重校验降低格式碰撞风险：

  1. 前缀匹配 $encrypted$
  2. token 部分必须是 Fernet 格式（version byte 0x80，base64 编码后以 g 开头， 且解码后总长度至少 57 字节 = 1 + 8 + 16 + 32）

这避免了与真实密码恰好以 $encrypted$ 开头时被误判的场景： 真实密码很少以 $encrypted$g 开头，且 base64 解码长度必须 >= 57 字节。

Attention: 本函数不验证 HMAC/签名，仅为廉价标识符检测； 完整合法性校验在 decrypt() 中完成。

def setup_logging( level: str = 'INFO', log_file: str | None = None, max_bytes: int = 10485760, backup_count: int = 5, structured: bool = False, verbose: bool = False) -> None: 
101def setup_logging(
102    level: str = "INFO",
103    log_file: Optional[str] = None,
104    max_bytes: int = 10 * 1024 * 1024,  # 10MB
105    backup_count: int = 5,
106    structured: bool = False,
107    verbose: bool = False,
108) -> None:
109    """
110    配置统一日志系统
111
112    Args:
113        level: 日志级别 (DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR/CRITICAL)
114        log_file: 日志文件路径（可选，不指定时只输出到控制台）
115        max_bytes: 单个日志文件最大字节数
116        backup_count: 保留的轮转文件数
117        structured: 是否使用 JSON 结构化格式
118        verbose: 是否启用详细格式
119    """
120    root_logger = logging.getLogger()
121    root_logger.setLevel(getattr(logging, level.upper(), logging.INFO))
122
123    # 清除已有处理器
124    root_logger.handlers.clear()
125
126    # 创建格式化器
127    if structured:
128        formatter = logging.Formatter(STRUCTURED_FORMAT)
129    elif verbose:
130        formatter = logging.Formatter(VERBOSE_FORMAT)
131    else:
132        formatter = logging.Formatter(DEFAULT_FORMAT)
133
134    # 添加敏感数据过滤器
135    sensitive_filter = SensitiveDataFilter()
136
137    # 控制台输出
138    console_handler = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stderr)
139    console_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
140    console_handler.addFilter(sensitive_filter)
141    root_logger.addHandler(console_handler)
142
143    # 文件输出（可选）
144    if log_file:
145        log_path = Path(log_file)
146        log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
147
148        file_handler = RotatingFileHandler(
149            str(log_path),
150            maxBytes=max_bytes,
151            backupCount=backup_count,
152            encoding="utf-8",
153        )
154        file_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
155        file_handler.addFilter(sensitive_filter)
156        root_logger.addHandler(file_handler)
157
158    # 配置 remote_cmd 包日志
159    logging.getLogger("remote_cmd").setLevel(getattr(logging, level.upper(), logging.INFO))
160
161    logging.getLogger("remote_cmd").debug("日志系统已初始化")

配置统一日志系统

class SensitiveDataFilter(logging.Filter): 
51class SensitiveDataFilter(logging.Filter):
52    """
53    日志过滤器：自动脱敏敏感数据
54
55    重写 filter 方法，在日志记录发出前替换敏感字段。
56    """
57
58    def filter(self, record: logging.LogRecord) -> bool:
59        if isinstance(record.msg, str):
60            record.msg = redact_sensitive_data(record.msg)
61        if record.args:
62            # 处理 %s 格式的参数
63            cleaned_args = tuple(
64                redact_sensitive_data(str(a)) if isinstance(a, str) else a for a in record.args
65            )
66            record.args = cleaned_args
67        return True
68
69    @staticmethod
70    def redact_dict(data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
71        """递归脱敏字典中的敏感字段"""
72        result: dict[str, Any] = {}
73        for key, value in data.items():
74            if key.lower() in SENSITIVE_FIELDS:
75                result[key] = "[REDACTED]"
76            elif isinstance(value, dict):
77                result[key] = SensitiveDataFilter.redact_dict(value)
78            else:
79                result[key] = value
80        return result

def get_logger(name: str, **context) -> 'logging.Logger | logging.LoggerAdapter': 
187def get_logger(name: str, **context) -> "logging.Logger | logging.LoggerAdapter":
188    """
189    获取带可选上下文的日志器
190
191    用法:
192        >>> log = get_logger(__name__, host="web-server")
193        >>> log.info("测试连接")
194    """
195    logger = logging.getLogger(name)
196    if context:
197        return LoggerAdapter(logger, context)
198    return logger

class SqliteHostRepository(remote_cmd.HostRepository): 
 67class SqliteHostRepository(HostRepository):
 68    """
 69    SQLite 主机仓库
 70
 71    Args:
 72        db_path: SQLite 数据库文件路径
 73        migrate_from: JSON 文件路径，用于自动迁移（仅首次使用）
 74        auto_create: 是否自动创建表和数据库，默认 True
 75    """
 76
 77    def __init__(
 78        self,
 79        db_path: str,
 80        migrate_from: Optional[str] = None,
 81        auto_create: bool = True,
 82    ):
 83        self._db_path = db_path
 84        self._lock = threading.Lock()
 85
 86        if auto_create:
 87            self._init_db()
 88
 89        if migrate_from:
 90            self._maybe_migrate_from_json(migrate_from)
 91
 92    # ========================================================================
 93    # 数据库初始化
 94    # ========================================================================
 95
 96    def _init_db(self) -> None:
 97        """初始化数据库：创建表和索引"""
 98        with self._txn() as conn:
 99            conn.execute(CREATE_TABLE_SQL)
100            conn.execute(CREATE_META_SQL)
101            for idx_sql in CREATE_INDEXES_SQL:
102                conn.execute(idx_sql)
103            # 设置数据库版本
104            conn.execute(
105                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO meta (key, value) VALUES (?, ?)",
106                ("db_version", str(DB_VERSION)),
107            )
108            conn.commit()
109        logger.debug(f"SQLite 数据库已初始化: {self._db_path}")
110
111    def _get_conn(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
112        """获取数据库连接（线程安全）"""
113        conn = sqlite3.connect(self._db_path, check_same_thread=False)
114        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
115        conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;")
116        conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;")
117        return conn
118
119    @contextlib.contextmanager
120    def _txn(self):
121        """
122        事务 + 连接生命周期上下文
123
124        包装 ``with conn:`` 与 ``conn.close()`` 为单一上下文：
125        - 进入时打开新连接并执行 PRAGMA
126        - 退出时先 ``conn.__exit__`` 提交/回滚，再 ``conn.close()`` 释放 fd
127
128        解决 ``with self._get_conn() as conn:`` 不自动 close 导致的 fd 累积泄漏
129        （sqlite3.Connection.__exit__ 仅管理事务边界，不释放连接句柄）。
130
131        所有读写操作都应通过 ``with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:`` 使用，
132        保证 ``self._lock`` 串行化的同时每次操作后释放 fd。
133        """
134        conn = self._get_conn()
135        try:
136            with conn:  # 事务：commit 或 rollback
137                yield conn
138        finally:
139            conn.close()
140
141    # ========================================================================
142    # JSON 迁移
143    # ========================================================================
144
145    def _maybe_migrate_from_json(self, json_path: str) -> None:
146        """
147        如果数据库为空且 JSON 文件存在，执行迁移
148
149        Args:
150            json_path: JSON 文件路径
151        """
152        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
153            count = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM hosts").fetchone()["cnt"]
154            if count > 0:
155                logger.info("数据库非空，跳过 JSON 迁移")
156                return
157
158        # 尝试加载 JSON 文件
159        try:
160            from pathlib import Path
161
162            path = Path(json_path)
163            if not path.exists():
164                logger.info(f"JSON 文件不存在，跳过迁移: {json_path}")
165                return
166
167            with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
168                raw_data = json.load(f)
169
170            # 解析版本格式
171            version = raw_data.get("version", 1)
172            hosts_data = raw_data.get("hosts", raw_data if version == 1 else {})
173
174            if not isinstance(hosts_data, dict):
175                logger.warning(f"无法识别的 JSON 格式: {json_path}")
176                return
177
178            imported = 0
179            for name, host_dict in hosts_data.items():
180                try:
181                    host = Host.from_dict(host_dict)
182                    self.save(host)
183                    imported += 1
184                except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as e:
185                    logger.warning(f"跳过无效主机 '{name}': {e}")
186
187            if imported > 0:
188                logger.info(f"从 JSON 迁移了 {imported} 台主机到 SQLite")
189
190        except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as e:
191            logger.warning(f"JSON 迁移失败: {e}")
192
193    # ========================================================================
194    # Repository 接口实现
195    # ========================================================================
196
197    def save(self, host: Host) -> None:
198        """保存或更新主机"""
199        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
200            tags_json = json.dumps(host.tags or [], ensure_ascii=False)
201            conn.execute(
202                """
203                    INSERT INTO hosts (name, hostname, username, port, password,
204                                       key_filename, tags, description, updated_at)
205                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
206                    ON CONFLICT(name) DO UPDATE SET
207                        hostname = excluded.hostname,
208                        username = excluded.username,
209                        port = excluded.port,
210                        password = excluded.password,
211                        key_filename = excluded.key_filename,
212                        tags = excluded.tags,
213                        description = excluded.description,
214                        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
215                    """,
216                (
217                    host.name,
218                    host.hostname,
219                    host.username,
220                    host.port,
221                    host.password,
222                    host.key_filename,
223                    tags_json,
224                    host.description,
225                ),
226            )
227            conn.commit()
228
229    def get(self, name: str) -> Host:
230        """按名称获取主机"""
231        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
232            row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM hosts WHERE name = ?", (name,)).fetchone()
233
234        if row is None:
235            raise KeyError(f"主机 '{name}' 不存在")
236
237        return self._row_to_host(row)
238
239    def delete(self, name: str) -> None:
240        """按名称删除主机"""
241        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
242            cursor = conn.execute("DELETE FROM hosts WHERE name = ?", (name,))
243            conn.commit()
244
245        if cursor.rowcount == 0:
246            raise KeyError(f"主机 '{name}' 不存在")
247
248    def list(self, tag: Optional[str] = None) -> list[Host]:
249        """列出主机，可选按标签筛选"""
250        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
251            if tag:
252                # 使用 LIKE 匹配 tags JSON 中的标签
253                rows = conn.execute(
254                    "SELECT * FROM hosts WHERE tags LIKE ? ORDER BY name",
255                    (f'%"{tag}"%',),
256                ).fetchall()
257            else:
258                rows = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM hosts ORDER BY name").fetchall()
259
260        return [self._row_to_host(row) for row in rows]
261
262    def list_tags(self) -> builtins.list[str]:
263        """列出所有标签"""
264        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
265            rows = conn.execute("SELECT DISTINCT tags FROM hosts WHERE tags IS NOT NULL").fetchall()
266
267        tags_set: set = set()
268        for row in rows:
269            try:
270                tags = json.loads(row["tags"] or "[]")
271                if isinstance(tags, list):
272                    tags_set.update(tags)
273            except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
274                pass
275
276        return sorted(tags_set)
277
278    def contains(self, name: str) -> bool:
279        """检查主机是否存在"""
280        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
281            row = conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM hosts WHERE name = ?", (name,)).fetchone()
282
283        return row is not None
284
285    def count(self) -> int:
286        """返回主机数量"""
287        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
288            row = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM hosts").fetchone()
289
290        return row["cnt"] if row else 0
291
292    def flush(self) -> None:
293        """
294        SQLite 写入即时生效，flush 为空操作
295        此处仅触发一个检查点以压缩 WAL 日志
296        """
297        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
298            conn.execute("PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE);")
299
300    # ========================================================================
301    # 扩展方法（非 ABC 接口）
302    # ========================================================================
303
304    def search(self, query: str) -> builtins.list[Host]:
305        """
306        模糊搜索主机
307
308        按名称、主机名、用户名、描述进行模糊匹配。
309
310        Args:
311            query: 搜索关键词
312
313        Returns:
314            List[Host]: 匹配的主机列表
315        """
316        pattern = f"%{query}%"
317        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
318            rows = conn.execute(
319                """
320                    SELECT * FROM hosts
321                    WHERE name LIKE ?
322                       OR hostname LIKE ?
323                       OR username LIKE ?
324                       OR description LIKE ?
325                    ORDER BY name
326                    """,
327                (pattern, pattern, pattern, pattern),
328            ).fetchall()
329
330        return [self._row_to_host(row) for row in rows]
331
332    def list_paginated(
333        self,
334        offset: int = 0,
335        limit: int = 20,
336        tag: Optional[str] = None,
337    ) -> tuple[builtins.list[Host], int]:
338        """
339        分页查询主机
340
341        Args:
342            offset: 偏移量
343            limit: 每页数量
344            tag: 可选标签筛选
345
346        Returns:
347            Tuple[List[Host], int]: (主机列表, 总数)
348        """
349        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
350            if tag:
351                count_row = conn.execute(
352                    "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM hosts WHERE tags LIKE ?",
353                    (f'%"{tag}"%',),
354                ).fetchone()
355                total = count_row["cnt"] if count_row else 0
356                rows = conn.execute(
357                    "SELECT * FROM hosts WHERE tags LIKE ? ORDER BY name LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",
358                    (f'%"{tag}"%', limit, offset),
359                ).fetchall()
360            else:
361                count_row = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM hosts").fetchone()
362                total = count_row["cnt"] if count_row else 0
363                rows = conn.execute(
364                    "SELECT * FROM hosts ORDER BY name LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",
365                    (limit, offset),
366                ).fetchall()
367
368        hosts = [self._row_to_host(row) for row in rows]
369        return hosts, total
370
371    # ========================================================================
372    # 内部辅助
373    # ========================================================================
374
375    @staticmethod
376    def _row_to_host(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Host:
377        """
378        将 SQLite 行转换为 Host 对象
379
380        Args:
381            row: SQLite 行对象
382
383        Returns:
384            Host: 主机配置对象
385        """
386        # 解析 tags JSON
387        tags = None
388        try:
389            raw_tags = row["tags"]
390            if raw_tags:
391                parsed = json.loads(raw_tags)
392                if isinstance(parsed, list):
393                    tags = parsed
394        except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
395            pass
396
397        return Host(
398            name=row["name"],
399            hostname=row["hostname"],
400            username=row["username"],
401            port=row["port"],
402            password=row["password"],
403            key_filename=row["key_filename"],
404            tags=tags,
405            description=row["description"] or "",
406        )

266
267        tags_set: set = set()

276        return sorted(tags_set)

def search(self, query: str) -> list[Host]: 
304    def search(self, query: str) -> builtins.list[Host]:
305        """
306        模糊搜索主机
307
308        按名称、主机名、用户名、描述进行模糊匹配。
309
310        Args:
311            query: 搜索关键词
312
313        Returns:
314            List[Host]: 匹配的主机列表
315        """
316        pattern = f"%{query}%"
317        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
318            rows = conn.execute(
319                """
320                    SELECT * FROM hosts
321                    WHERE name LIKE ?
322                       OR hostname LIKE ?
323                       OR username LIKE ?
324                       OR description LIKE ?
325                    ORDER BY name
326                    """,
327                (pattern, pattern, pattern, pattern),
328            ).fetchall()
329
330        return [self._row_to_host(row) for row in rows]

def list_paginated( self, offset: int = 0, limit: int = 20, tag: str | None = None) -> tuple[list[Host], int]: 
332    def list_paginated(
333        self,
334        offset: int = 0,
335        limit: int = 20,
336        tag: Optional[str] = None,
337    ) -> tuple[builtins.list[Host], int]:
338        """
339        分页查询主机
340
341        Args:
342            offset: 偏移量
343            limit: 每页数量
344            tag: 可选标签筛选
345
346        Returns:
347            Tuple[List[Host], int]: (主机列表, 总数)
348        """
349        with self._lock, self._txn() as conn:
350            if tag:
351                count_row = conn.execute(
352                    "SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM hosts WHERE tags LIKE ?",
353                    (f'%"{tag}"%',),
354                ).fetchone()
355                total = count_row["cnt"] if count_row else 0
356                rows = conn.execute(
357                    "SELECT * FROM hosts WHERE tags LIKE ? ORDER BY name LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",
358                    (f'%"{tag}"%', limit, offset),
359                ).fetchall()
360            else:
361                count_row = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM hosts").fetchone()
362                total = count_row["cnt"] if count_row else 0
363                rows = conn.execute(
364                    "SELECT * FROM hosts ORDER BY name LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",
365                    (limit, offset),
366                ).fetchall()
367
368        hosts = [self._row_to_host(row) for row in rows]
369        return hosts, total

class BatchExecutor: 
113class BatchExecutor:
114    """
115    批量命令执行器
116
117    支持多主机并发执行，带超时控制、失败重试和进度回调。
118
119    Args:
120        host_service: HostService 实例，用于获取主机配置和凭据
121        max_concurrency: 最大并发数，默认 10
122        command_timeout: 单个命令超时时间（秒），默认 30
123        use_async: 是否启用异步内核（基于 asyncssh 的原生异步实现）。默认 False
124            保持原有 ThreadPoolExecutor 行为；设为 True 时，execute 会在内部使用
125            asyncio.run 调用 AsyncBatchExecutor 完成并发调度，从而在大规模场景下
126            降低线程/CPU 开销。注意：启用时调用线程不应已运行 asyncio 事件循环。
127
128    Note:
129        无论 `use_async` 取值，对外 `execute` 始终为同步接口，返回类型一致，
130        便于上层无差别切换。
131    """
132
133    def __init__(
134        self,
135        host_service: HostService,
136        max_concurrency: int = 10,
137        command_timeout: int = 30,
138        use_async: bool = False,
139    ):
140        self._host_service = host_service
141        self._max_concurrency = max_concurrency
142        self._command_timeout = command_timeout
143        self._use_async = use_async
144        # 延迟导入以避免在未安装 asyncssh 的环境下的导入失败
145        # 使用前向引用避免在模块加载期引入 asyncssh 硬依赖（开启 use_async 时才惰性导入）
146        self._async_executor: Optional["AsyncBatchExecutor"] = None  # noqa: UP037
147        if use_async:
148            from remote_cmd.service.async_batch_executor import AsyncBatchExecutor
149
150            self._async_executor = AsyncBatchExecutor(
151                host_service=host_service,
152                max_concurrency=max_concurrency,
153                command_timeout=command_timeout,
154            )
155
156    def execute(
157        self,
158        host_names: list[str],
159        command: str,
160        retry_count: int = 0,
161        retry_delay: float = 1.0,
162        progress_callback: Optional[ProgressCallback] = None,
163    ) -> BatchResult:
164        """
165        在指定主机上批量执行命令
166
167        Args:
168            host_names: 要执行命令的主机名称列表
169            command: 要执行的命令
170            retry_count: 失败重试次数，默认 0（不重试）
171            retry_delay: 重试间隔（秒），默认 1.0
172            progress_callback: 进度回调，参数 (completed, total, current_host_name)。
173                同步内核下回调应为同步函数；异步回调请使用 use_async=True。
174
175        Returns:
176            BatchResult: 批量执行结果
177
178        Raises:
179            ValueError: host_names 为空
180        """
181        if not host_names:
182            raise ValueError("主机列表不能为空")
183
184        # 异步内核委托路径：同步接口 + asyncio.run(异步实现)
185        if self._async_executor is not None:
186            import asyncio
187
188            # 保证空列表校验语义一致（已在上方判断）
189            return asyncio.run(
190                self._async_executor.execute(
191                    host_names=host_names,
192                    command=command,
193                    retry_count=retry_count,
194                    retry_delay=retry_delay,
195                    progress_callback=progress_callback,
196                )
197            )
198
199        total = len(host_names)
200        results: dict[str, BatchHostResult] = {}
201        completed = 0
202        start_time = time.time()
203
204        logger.info(
205            f"批量执行开始: {total} 台主机, 并发数={self._max_concurrency}, 命令='{command}'"
206        )
207
208        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=self._max_concurrency) as executor:
209            future_map = {
210                executor.submit(
211                    self._execute_on_host,
212                    host_name,
213                    command,
214                    retry_count,
215                    retry_delay,
216                ): host_name
217                for host_name in host_names
218            }
219
220            try:
221                for future in as_completed(future_map):
222                    host_name = future_map[future]
223                    try:
224                        result = future.result()
225                    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
226                        result = BatchHostResult(
227                            host=host_name,
228                            success=False,
229                            command=command,
230                            error=f"计划异常: {e}",
231                        )
232                    results[host_name] = result
233                    completed += 1
234
235                    if progress_callback:
236                        rv = progress_callback(completed, total, host_name)
237                        if inspect.isawaitable(rv):
238                            logger.warning(
239                                "同步内核不支持异步进度回调，请使用 use_async=True"
240                            )
241
242                    logger.debug(
243                        f"[{completed}/{total}] {host_name}: "
244                        f"{'✓' if result.success else '✗'} "
245                        f"({result.duration:.1f}s)"
246                    )
247
248            except KeyboardInterrupt:
249                logger.warning("用户中断批量执行")
250                # 取消所有未完成的任务
251                for future in future_map:
252                    future.cancel()
253                # 为尚未有结果的主机创建失败记录
254                for host_name in host_names:
255                    if host_name not in results:
256                        results[host_name] = BatchHostResult(
257                            host=host_name,
258                            success=False,
259                            command=command,
260                            error="用户中断",
261                        )
262                        completed += 1
263
264        duration = time.time() - start_time
265        success_count = sum(1 for r in results.values() if r.success)
266        failed_count = total - success_count
267
268        logger.info(f"批量执行完成: {success_count}/{total} 成功, 耗时 {duration:.1f}s")
269
270        return BatchResult(
271            total=total,
272            success=success_count,
273            failed=failed_count,
274            duration=duration,
275            results=results,
276        )
277
278    def _execute_on_host(
279        self,
280        host_name: str,
281        command: str,
282        retry_count: int,
283        retry_delay: float,
284    ) -> BatchHostResult:
285        """
286        在单台主机上执行命令（包含重试逻辑）
287
288        Args:
289            host_name: 主机名称
290            command: 要执行的命令
291            retry_count: 重试次数
292            retry_delay: 重试间隔
293
294        Returns:
295            BatchHostResult: 单台主机的执行结果
296        """
297        # 解析主机配置（包括凭据解密）
298        try:
299            host: Host = self._host_service.resolve_host(host_name)
300        except KeyError as e:
301            return BatchHostResult(
302                host=host_name,
303                success=False,
304                command=command,
305                error=f"主机不存在: {e}",
306            )
307        except (RuntimeError, OSError) as e:
308            return BatchHostResult(
309                host=host_name,
310                success=False,
311                command=command,
312                error=f"主机解析失败: {e}",
313            )
314
315        last_error: Optional[str] = None
316
317        for attempt in range(retry_count + 1):
318            start = time.time()
319            try:
320                config = ConnectionConfig(
321                    hostname=host.hostname,
322                    username=host.username,
323                    port=host.port,
324                    password=host.password,
325                    key_filename=host.key_filename,
326                    timeout=self._command_timeout,
327                )
328
329                client = SSHClient(config)
330                client.connect()
331                cmd_result = client.execute(command, timeout=self._command_timeout)
332                client.disconnect()
333
334                duration = time.time() - start
335
336                return BatchHostResult(
337                    host=host_name,
338                    success=cmd_result.success,
339                    command=command,
340                    stdout=cmd_result.stdout,
341                    stderr=cmd_result.stderr,
342                    exit_code=cmd_result.exit_code,
343                    duration=duration,
344                )
345
346            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
347                duration = time.time() - start
348                last_error = str(e)
349                logger.debug(f"{host_name} 第 {attempt + 1}/{retry_count + 1} 次尝试失败: {e}")
350
351                # 如果不是最后一次尝试，等待后重试
352                if attempt < retry_count:
353                    time.sleep(retry_delay)
354
355        # 所有重试都失败
356        return BatchHostResult(
357            host=host_name,
358            success=False,
359            command=command,
360            error=last_error,
361            duration=0.0,
362        )

Note: 无论 use_async 取值，对外 execute 始终为同步接口，返回类型一致， 便于上层无差别切换。

109            f"成功率: {self.success_rate:.1%}"
110        )

class TaskRunner: 
 75class TaskRunner:
 76    """
 77    后台任务运行器
 78
 79    支持任务提交、取消、状态查询和等待完成。
 80    使用 threading.Thread 执行后台任务，通过 Semaphore 控制并发。
 81
 82    Args:
 83        max_workers: 最大并发任务数，默认 10
 84    """
 85
 86    def __init__(self, max_workers: int = 10):
 87        self._max_workers = max_workers
 88        self._tasks: dict[str, Task] = {}
 89        self._events: dict[str, threading.Event] = {}
 90        self._cancel_flags: dict[str, threading.Event] = {}
 91        self._semaphore = threading.Semaphore(max_workers)
 92        self._lock = threading.Lock()
 93
 94    # ========================================================================
 95    # 任务管理
 96    # ========================================================================
 97
 98    def submit(
 99        self,
100        name: str,
101        fn: Callable[..., Any],
102        *args: Any,
103        metadata: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None,
104        **kwargs: Any,
105    ) -> str:
106        """
107        提交一个后台任务
108
109        Args:
110            name: 任务名称（用于显示和日志）
111            fn: 要执行的函数
112            *args: 函数参数
113            metadata: 任务元数据（可选）
114            **kwargs: 函数关键字参数
115
116        Returns:
117            str: 任务 ID
118
119        Raises:
120            ValueError: 任务名称不能为空
121        """
122        if not name:
123            raise ValueError("任务名称不能为空")
124
125        task_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
126        task = Task(
127            id=task_id,
128            name=name,
129            status=TaskStatus.PENDING,
130            created_at=datetime.now(),
131            metadata=metadata or {},
132        )
133
134        with self._lock:
135            self._tasks[task_id] = task
136            self._events[task_id] = threading.Event()
137            self._cancel_flags[task_id] = threading.Event()
138
139        # 获取信号量后再启动线程（限制并发）
140        self._semaphore.acquire()
141
142        # 若在等待信号量期间任务已被取消，放弃启动并归还槽位。
143        # （cancel(PENDING) 只 set cancel_flag 不 release，槽位配对关系：
144        #  submit.acquire() ↔ 本处 release 或 _execute_wrapper.finally）
145        if self._cancel_flags.get(task_id, threading.Event()).is_set():
146            self._semaphore.release()
147            logger.info(f"任务在调度前已取消: [{task_id[:8]}] {task.name}")
148            return task_id
149
150        thread = threading.Thread(
151            target=self._execute_wrapper,
152            args=(task_id, fn, args, kwargs),
153            daemon=True,
154            name=f"task-{name[:16]}-{task_id[:8]}",
155        )
156        thread.start()
157
158        logger.info(f"任务已提交: [{task_id[:8]}] {name}")
159        return task_id
160
161    def cancel(self, task_id: str) -> bool:
162        """
163        取消一个任务
164
165        对于 PENDING 状态的任务直接标记取消。
166        对于 RUNNING 状态的任务设置取消标志（需要函数内部检查）。
167
168        Args:
169            task_id: 任务 ID
170
171        Returns:
172            bool: 取消成功返回 True
173        """
174        with self._lock:
175            task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
176            if task is None:
177                return False
178
179            if task.status == TaskStatus.PENDING:
180                task.status = TaskStatus.CANCELLED
181                task.completed_at = datetime.now()
182                # 设置取消标志：阻塞在信号量 acquire 的 submit 线程在拿到
183                # 槽位后会检查该标志，发现已取消则放弃启动并归还槽位。
184                # 注意：此处不 release 信号量 —— 槽位配对关系为
185                # submit.acquire() ↔ (_execute_wrapper.finally 或 submit 放弃时)
186                # 的 release，cancel 介入会破坏对称性导致双 release（P0-C）。
187                if task_id in self._cancel_flags:
188                    self._cancel_flags[task_id].set()
189                if task_id in self._events:
190                    self._events[task_id].set()
191                logger.info(f"任务已取消: [{task_id[:8]}] {task.name}")
192                return True
193
194            if task.status == TaskStatus.RUNNING:
195                # 设置取消标志
196                if task_id in self._cancel_flags:
197                    self._cancel_flags[task_id].set()
198                logger.info(f"正在取消任务: [{task_id[:8]}] {task.name}")
199                return True
200
201            return False
202
203    def get_task(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[Task]:
204        """
205        获取任务信息
206
207        Args:
208            task_id: 任务 ID
209
210        Returns:
211            Optional[Task]: 任务对象，不存在时返回 None
212        """
213        with self._lock:
214            task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
215            if task is None:
216                return None
217            # 返回副本避免外部修改
218            import dataclasses
219
220            return dataclasses.replace(task)
221
222    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskStatus]:
223        """
224        获取任务状态
225
226        Args:
227            task_id: 任务 ID
228
229        Returns:
230            Optional[TaskStatus]: 任务状态，不存在时返回 None
231        """
232        with self._lock:
233            task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
234            return task.status if task else None
235
236    def list_tasks(
237        self,
238        status: Optional[TaskStatus] = None,
239        limit: int = 50,
240    ) -> list[Task]:
241        """
242        列出任务
243
244        Args:
245            status: 按状态筛选（可选）
246            limit: 最大返回数量，默认 50
247
248        Returns:
249            List[Task]: 任务列表（按创建时间降序）
250        """
251        with self._lock:
252            tasks = list(self._tasks.values())
253
254        # 按创建时间降序排序
255        tasks.sort(key=lambda t: t.created_at, reverse=True)
256
257        # 按状态筛选
258        if status:
259            tasks = [t for t in tasks if t.status == status]
260
261        return tasks[:limit]
262
263    def wait_for(self, task_id: str, timeout: Optional[float] = None) -> Task:
264        """
265        等待任务完成
266
267        Args:
268            task_id: 任务 ID
269            timeout: 超时时间（秒），None 表示无限等待
270
271        Returns:
272            Task: 已完成的任务
273
274        Raises:
275            TimeoutError: 等待超时
276            KeyError: 任务不存在
277        """
278        with self._lock:
279            if task_id not in self._events:
280                raise KeyError(f"任务 '{task_id[:8]}' 不存在")
281            event = self._events[task_id]
282
283        if not event.wait(timeout=timeout):
284            raise TimeoutError(f"等待任务 '{task_id[:8]}' 超时")
285
286        task = self.get_task(task_id)
287        if task is None:
288            raise KeyError(f"任务 '{task_id[:8]}' 不存在")
289        return task
290
291    def cancel_all(self) -> int:
292        """
293        取消所有 PENDING 状态的任务
294
295        Returns:
296            int: 已取消的任务数
297        """
298        count = 0
299        with self._lock:
300            for task_id, task in list(self._tasks.items()):
301                if task.status == TaskStatus.PENDING:
302                    task.status = TaskStatus.CANCELLED
303                    task.completed_at = datetime.now()
304                    # 与 cancel(PENDING) 一致：只设标志不释放信号量。
305                    # 阻塞在 acquire 的 submit 线程拿到槽位后会检查标志，
306                    # 发现已取消则归还槽位并放弃启动（P0-C）。
307                    if task_id in self._cancel_flags:
308                        self._cancel_flags[task_id].set()
309                    if task_id in self._events:
310                        self._events[task_id].set()
311                    count += 1
312
313        if count > 0:
314            logger.info(f"已取消 {count} 个待处理任务")
315        return count
316
317    def cleanup_old(self, max_age_seconds: int = 3600) -> int:
318        """
319        清理过期任务
320
321        Args:
322            max_age_seconds: 最大保留时间（秒），默认 1 小时
323
324        Returns:
325            int: 已清理的任务数
326        """
327        now = datetime.now()
328        to_remove: list[str] = []
329
330        with self._lock:
331            for task_id, task in list(self._tasks.items()):
332                if (
333                    task.status
334                    in (
335                        TaskStatus.SUCCESS,
336                        TaskStatus.FAILED,
337                        TaskStatus.CANCELLED,
338                    )
339                    and task.completed_at
340                ):
341                    age = (now - task.completed_at).total_seconds()
342                    if age > max_age_seconds:
343                        to_remove.append(task_id)
344
345            for task_id in to_remove:
346                del self._tasks[task_id]
347                self._events.pop(task_id, None)
348                self._cancel_flags.pop(task_id, None)
349
350        if to_remove:
351            logger.debug(f"已清理 {len(to_remove)} 个过期任务")
352        return len(to_remove)
353
354    # ========================================================================
355    # 属性
356    # ========================================================================
357
358    @property
359    def active_count(self) -> int:
360        """当前运行中的任务数"""
361        return self._max_workers - self._semaphore._value  # noqa: SLF001
362
363    @property
364    def pending_count(self) -> int:
365        """当前待处理的任务数"""
366        count = 0
367        with self._lock:
368            for task in self._tasks.values():
369                if task.status == TaskStatus.PENDING:
370                    count += 1
371        return count
372
373    # ========================================================================
374    # 内部方法
375    # ========================================================================
376
377    def _execute_wrapper(
378        self,
379        task_id: str,
380        fn: Callable,
381        args: tuple,
382        kwargs: dict,
383    ) -> None:
384        """
385        任务执行包装器
386
387        负责状态转换、取消检查、异常处理和资源释放。
388        """
389        # 检查是否在启动前已被取消（竞态窗口：cancel 发生在 submit 检查之后、
390        # 本线程启动之前）。已获取的槽位必须归还，否则信号量泄漏。
391        if self._cancel_flags.get(task_id, threading.Event()).is_set():
392            self._semaphore.release()
393            with self._lock:
394                task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
395                if task and task.status == TaskStatus.PENDING:
396                    task.status = TaskStatus.CANCELLED
397                    task.completed_at = datetime.now()
398            if task_id in self._events:
399                self._events[task_id].set()
400            return
401
402        # 设置为运行中
403        with self._lock:
404            task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
405            if task:
406                task.status = TaskStatus.RUNNING
407                task.started_at = datetime.now()
408
409        try:
410            logger.debug(f"任务开始: [{task_id[:8]}] 执行中...")
411
412            # 执行任务函数
413            result = fn(*args, **kwargs)
414
415            # 检查是否在执行期间被取消
416            if self._cancel_flags.get(task_id, threading.Event()).is_set():
417                with self._lock:
418                    task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
419                    if task:
420                        task.status = TaskStatus.CANCELLED
421                        task.completed_at = datetime.now()
422                logger.info(f"任务被取消: [{task_id[:8]}]")
423            else:
424                with self._lock:
425                    task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
426                    if task:
427                        task.result = result
428                        task.status = TaskStatus.SUCCESS
429                        task.completed_at = datetime.now()
430                logger.info(f"任务完成: [{task_id[:8]}]")
431
432        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
433            with self._lock:
434                task = self._tasks.get(task_id)
435                if task and task.status != TaskStatus.CANCELLED:
436                    task.error = str(e)
437                    task.status = TaskStatus.FAILED
438                    task.completed_at = datetime.now()
439            logger.error(f"任务失败: [{task_id[:8]}] {e}")
440
441        finally:
442            self._semaphore.release()
443            if task_id in self._events:
444                self._events[task_id].set()

291    def cancel_all(self) -> int:
292        """
293        取消所有 PENDING 状态的任务
294
295        Returns:
296            int: 已取消的任务数
297        """
298        count = 0
299        with self._lock:
300            for task_id, task in list(self._tasks.items()):
301                if task.status == TaskStatus.PENDING:
302                    task.status = TaskStatus.CANCELLED
303                    task.completed_at = datetime.now()
304                    # 与 cancel(PENDING) 一致：只设标志不释放信号量。
305                    # 阻塞在 acquire 的 submit 线程拿到槽位后会检查标志，
306                    # 发现已取消则归还槽位并放弃启动（P0-C）。
307                    if task_id in self._cancel_flags:
308                        self._cancel_flags[task_id].set()
309                    if task_id in self._events:
310                        self._events[task_id].set()
311                    count += 1
312
313        if count > 0:
314            logger.info(f"已取消 {count} 个待处理任务")
315        return count

取消所有 PENDING 状态的任务

Returns: int: 已取消的任务数

def cleanup_old(self, max_age_seconds: int = 3600) -> int: 
317    def cleanup_old(self, max_age_seconds: int = 3600) -> int:
318        """
319        清理过期任务
320
321        Args:
322            max_age_seconds: 最大保留时间（秒），默认 1 小时
323
324        Returns:
325            int: 已清理的任务数
326        """
327        now = datetime.now()
328        to_remove: list[str] = []
329
330        with self._lock:
331            for task_id, task in list(self._tasks.items()):
332                if (
333                    task.status
334                    in (
335                        TaskStatus.SUCCESS,
336                        TaskStatus.FAILED,
337                        TaskStatus.CANCELLED,
338                    )
339                    and task.completed_at
340                ):
341                    age = (now - task.completed_at).total_seconds()
342                    if age > max_age_seconds:
343                        to_remove.append(task_id)
344
345            for task_id in to_remove:
346                del self._tasks[task_id]
347                self._events.pop(task_id, None)
348                self._cancel_flags.pop(task_id, None)
349
350        if to_remove:
351            logger.debug(f"已清理 {len(to_remove)} 个过期任务")
352        return len(to_remove)

清理过期任务

Args: max_age_seconds: 最大保留时间（秒），默认 1 小时

Returns: int: 已清理的任务数

class KeyringCredentialProvider(remote_cmd.CredentialProvider): 
117class KeyringCredentialProvider(CredentialProvider):
118    """
119    Keyring 凭据提供者
120
121    使用系统 Keyring 服务（Windows Credential Manager / macOS Keychain / Linux Secret Service）
122    获取密码。需要安装 keyring 库（pip install keyring）。
123
124    在凭据链中的位置：EnvCredentialProvider 之后，EncryptedFileCredentialProvider 之前。
125
126    Args:
127        service_name: Keyring 服务名称，默认 "remote-cmd"
128    """
129
130    def __init__(self, service_name: str = "remote-cmd"):
131        self._service_name = service_name
132
133    def get_password(self, host: Host) -> Optional[str]:
134        """
135        从系统 Keyring 获取密码
136
137        使用 keyring.get_password(service_name, host.name) 获取。
138        keyring 库为可选依赖，未安装时静默返回 None。
139
140        Args:
141            host: 主机配置对象
142
143        Returns:
144            Optional[str]: 密码，未找到或不可用时返回 None
145        """
146        try:
147            import keyring
148
149            password = keyring.get_password(self._service_name, host.name)
150            if password:
151                logger.debug(f"从 Keyring 获取到 {host.name} 的密码")
152            return password
153        except ImportError:
154            logger.debug("keyring 库未安装，跳过 KeyringCredentialProvider")
155            return None
156        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
157            logger.debug(f"Keyring 访问失败: {e}")
158            return None
159
160    def set_password(self, host: Host, password: str) -> bool:
161        """
162        向 Keyring 存储密码
163
164        Args:
165            host: 主机配置对象
166            password: 要存储的密码
167
168        Returns:
169            bool: 存储成功返回 True
170        """
171        try:
172            import keyring
173
174            keyring.set_password(self._service_name, host.name, password)
175            return True
176        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
177            logger.debug(f"Keyring 存储失败: {e}")
178            return False
179
180    def delete_password(self, host: Host) -> bool:
181        """
182        从 Keyring 删除密码
183
184        Args:
185            host: 主机配置对象
186
187        Returns:
188            bool: 删除成功返回 True
189        """
190        try:
191            import keyring
192
193            keyring.delete_password(self._service_name, host.name)
194            return True
195        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
196            logger.debug(f"Keyring 删除失败: {e}")
197            return False
